| | | Hey - I'm Byron Donalds.

The Republican National Committee named me the Co-Chairman of their most important initiative for the next election.

_**[I have a plan for a CONSERVATIVE LANDSLIDE in 2024- here's the gist:](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=a0b5dcc0dbb5464991584d87b142cd5f&_e=c9HE0go6XQsRFiHVFXYs1itudYumGsf4tUrHsj8mALAFxcDU_YoVV-k7aKjL16Aj6dVS0V_qnjMdQIYdE-RxJPlG2ers0Ev2-9t_eyqoNU7k_5VCYMp-kq5OqGIrgDXHwSJ556wve3BOkw-nghtPWVqiuEaVZsbWEN2PLdJtL9IWA4YbHmj8XswV1873g4M-Xzid-fDc0BwNwUD3-O1-lAiBR2QYXk1H8AzVFg5ntT7HFXxQuhlRfMnB1DBDU3NOiEhRFDAz-hLVMi1a4Wdifn3r630P_2o5LZeRFgnYTTeKoZtpfR7pcWjkt6MVJGCPMCkYwz33ELFbvV7eQdnxQCzl-1NCn309b8gF2fJgaRBkAzKIA9MScAn6cbyKntM8qDn3GfQFb2w5VisjTgfdJM3gKMQgu5hvVgb9nOk2Vfw%3D "I have a plan for a CONSERVATIVE LANDSLIDE in 2024 – here’s the gist:")**_
* If the Democrats vote early, we should push early voting too
* If they can ballot harvest, we should ballot harvest even better
* Invest in an 80,000-person team to ensure your vote is protected
* Mobilize GOP voters through neighbor-to-neighbor contact
* Expand voter contact efforts to connect with young Conservatives
* **Fight BAD ballot harvesting laws - let's make it easy to vote but hard to cheat**

I am proud to lead these efforts and help Conservatives WIN BIG up and down the ballot. These efforts will not only allow us to confront bad actors and stop cheating but will help our Party appeal to younger voters and swing-state independents.

body:
No images? [Click here](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-e-mflrtt-didthutlhu-yd/) [](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-mflrtt-didthutlhu-r/) **June 3, 2024** Friend --Read our latest update below!-Team WisGOP
# **In Case You Missed It**
**[WisGOP Statement on President Trump's Trial Verdict](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-mflrtt-didthutlhu-y/)**
If you are covering the verdict of President Trump's trial in Manhattan today, please consider the following statement from WisGOP Chairman Brian Schimming:"This is a dark day for America. Democrats have weaponized the legal system with their politically motivated prosecution of President Trump. Today's verdict is a national embarrassment. And voters will make their disapproval known this November when they vote to restore President Trump to the White House." --WisGOP Chairman Brian Schimming**[WisGOP Announces RNC Delegates and Alternates](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-mflrtt-didthutlhu-j/)**
The Republican Party of Wisconsin announced its slate of delegates and alternates for the 2024 Republican National Convention in Milwaukee. "It is an honor to represent the state of Wisconsin at the Republican National Convention," WisGOP Chairman Brian Schimming said. "We know that the passion and unity of Republican voters will be on display in our delegation. And we are thrilled to welcome our neighbors to Wisconsin to nominate President Donald Trump." **[Biden is Failing to Shore up Pennsylvania and Black Americans](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-mflrtt-didthutlhu-t/)**
The Keystone State is Crumbling Under Biden's Administration
Biden's Policies Have Left Black Americans Behind
Bidenomics is Failing Pennsylvanians
Democrats' Pro-Criminal Agenda Puts Pennsylvanians at Risk**[Trump in the Bronx:"We Are All Americans"](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-mflrtt-didthutlhu-i/)**
Tens of thousands of hardworking Patriots rallying in the Bronx was an incredible display in an area [long forgotten](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-mflrtt-didthutlhu-d/) by Democrat politicians who take their voices for granted.**[A Costly Memorial Day for Americans](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-mflrtt-didthutlhu-h/)**
As we gather with friends and family this holiday weekend, let's honor the sacrifices of our veterans and remember what Biden's failed leadership has led to. ****

subject: Judicial Watch: Biden Justice Department Admits Special Counsel Transcript of Biden Interviews Is Inaccurate
body:
Judicial Watch announced that the White House admitted in a federal court that the transcript of President Joe Biden’s testimony to Special Counsel Robert Hur is not accurate and is missing “filler words (such as ‘um’ or ‘uh’)” and words that “may have been repeated when spoken (such as ‘I, I’ or ‘and, and’)” which were sometimes “only listed a single time in the transcripts.”

### [Air Force Paid For Drag Queen To Appear At ‘Bingo’ Event And ‘Glow Party,’ Docs Show ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68551&L=32579&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvYWlyLWZvcmNlLXBhaWQtZm9yLWRyYWctcXVlZW4tdG8tYXBwZWFyLWF0LWJpbmdvLWV2ZW50LWFuZC1nbG93LXBhcnR5LWRvY3Mtc2hvdy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249dGlwc2hlZXQmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=7aa77ccb35fed98d6a2ced8f575632e8bd5cedf9fdd5bde5763c7caa29cbf906) The Daily Caller The Air Force paid for bingo and party events attended by a drag queen in 2022, according to records obtained by Judicial Watch.

subject: A Congressman For The People.
body:
Not one dime in corporate donations. | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us21.campaign-archive.com/?e=5d7e9a146c&u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=904e885910)

# A message from Ro Khanna:

In one week, South Carolina primary voters will head to the polls. We need to make sure they pick Mal Hyman, a common-sense progressive, for Congress. There’s just one problem: Like me, Mal has pledged not to take a dime of corporate donations. That means he depends on grassroots donors like you and me to fuel his campaign to victory.
Let me tell you why I’m proud to support Mal for Congress. [But first, can you rush a donation to his campaign so he has the resources to win his primary?](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=d670a6f2f7&e=5d7e9a146c)
---
|
Mal Hyman has been there and done it. He spent his career as an educator, teaching in public schools, men’s prisons, and for three decades at Coker University in Hartsville. He is ready to fight to ensure working families get a fair shake in Washington. That means fighting for:
* A living wage;
* Healthcare as a human right;
* Access to abortion;
* Quality, affordable childcare;
* Strengthening Social Security;
* A safe and clean environment;
* And more.

We need progressive champions like Mal in Congress who will prioritize working families and everyday Americans over special interests. But we can’t do it without your help.
[Will you split a donation between our campaigns right now and help send Mal to Washington?](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=7ffe6e7776&e=5d7e9a146c)
---

| Thank you for your support, activism, and all you do. In solidarity,Ro

A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we can communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we...
* Consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America.

name: Jenny Beth Martin, Tea Party Patriots Action
subject: CTA June 4th: Stop noncitizens from voting!
body:
Tell members of Congress to support the SAVE Act
| | | |
---
|
---
| Patriot-

---
| **** The left will do everything they can to maintain their grip on power - including convicting President Trump of a made-up crime and refusing to stop noncitizens from voting. While last week was devastating to our nation's founding principle of justice and due process, now, more than ever, is the time to fight for America.
We have an election in November that you can help secure by reaching out to your representative in the House and both of your senators and telling them, regardless of their political affiliation, that they **_must_** sign on as a co-sponsor of the [Safeguarding American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act.](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb979494b6f0e6/1edb979494b62ee6 "https://www.onlycitizensvotecoalition.com/")
The SAVE Act will require documentary proof of citizenship at the time of voter registration; which is **__not__** currently required by law. In fact, a [new study](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb979494b6f0e6/1edb979494b62ee8) found that between 10%-27% of noncitizen adults are registered to vote. That's mind blowing, especially since the Democrats claim noncitizens never vote in American elections.Find out who has signed on to co-sponsor this bill in the:
* Senate: [**S.4292**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb979494b6f0e6/1edb979494b62eea)
* House of Representatives: [**HB 8281**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb979494b6f0e6/1edb979494b62eec)
If your representative and/or senators are on the list, call and say thank you. But if they're not on the list yet, make sure you call and tell them that they should be. If your elected officials are Democrats, call anyway, because they need to feel the heat. [****](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb979494b6f0e6/1edb979494b62eee) **** ************

Thank you and let's get to it!
In liberty,
Jenny Beth Martin [****](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb979494b6f0e6/1edb979494b62ef8) **** ************

Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.

Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight."
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **" Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." **

We are one week away from election day. We have worked hard on our campaign to show that we can be the voice for the Second District for voters who have been left behind by Washington, D.C.
Our grassroots support has been growing week by week, day by day and now it is a surging minute by minute as we head into the closing days of the primary. Our record of legislative accomplishments and conservative voting record speak for themselves. The endorsements from over 50 individuals with legislative experience backs that up.
I wanted to talk to you about the veteran vote. Maine has the largest veteran population in the nation. Many vets, including Republicans and Unenrolled voters, have supported Jared Golden in the past because he served in the military. He's always gotten those votes and that's why he wins.
I will take that advantage away from him in the general election when I win the primary. The only way we take back the Second District is a Marine versus Marine match up. That will force Jared to talk about issues, policy and his voting record. Veteran versus veteran is how we win in November.

Thank you,
\- Mike

## GOP Hammers Fauci in Hearing
Dr. Anthony Fauci was [grilled Monday by a GOP-led congressional committee](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLuOrDAQBb_GZEamMQ8HDm5CNjfdEBnTDL3yY4Qb0Pz9ajbe7BxVUqqvx_xwFCg9_7uIlrc8O8904dxLLUHPulrthgjYVmiboRk6pcG01W6xbV23etzM2HQw-l6ptl8ADeDo1TJWZEGBVr3Saux6ZepxMWPT62HVpnXGKaEVrsT5qL8zJd5xC-984VH7HKtgd-ZXEe0_AZOA6b7v2i8l4V0-XMD0mQIml3jP6S03d3qSjIUpfv6ez4KyYEDPspyLzzESM6LMSfKO0ucjJ3fRcRb5cmnFSF7AVB12fd0UApV-EFo9o6Pwq8R_9rks_AQAAP__a5pq3A) investigating the government's pandemic response in his first public appearance since he retired 18 months ago. Republican committee members questioned Fauci about the origin of Covid-19, accusing him of blocking investigations into the theory that the virus leaked from a Chinese lab. Democrats on the committee defended Fauci's actions, [calling him a hero](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFurDAQheGnMR1oPHgNLlzcxt3eNiWatQeYyItX4IDy9tGmTnOqI33S_3Gf7iRZtuU_PdnXuUwUq5w82da0aCbTJD8zI_cNez3o4QYGXd-sHkbHBDxHaxM9WBM5BoiJ4QYOmBvxCGjAgoHxZsF148ON2pohGdeTI1AGOEkte_dZZKsrz_m7nLx3sTyb7NdaX4fq_ykMCsN1Xd2rZKkSy_ugMGx8HQrDW1EYwL6nVxhm-orSxrItOx9HG8spqV2ZdtmWFkBbjePQ7D69LslZDjsoA8uTJP_K9c8Mp8efAAAA__9Hz11G). _" Fauci, you belong in jail!"_ a heckler shouted during the hearing before he was escorted out. [You can read highlights of the hearing here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGu2yAUgOGngY3oBDCYgaGLt3TtaGE4hFMRY2HiKm9f3Tvf-R9-6fvzWB-BKu3P3-GFfuS2hjjowtUILaReNU8-I0pUHP3d3u0EWjrFi7cAWSXQyhrcLGSbMtqYJjQzbtsUOHkJUoMBDfNkwN3mzc13o23STgUXgGnARKP1299G-yiY66dd2G-xvXj1ZYzjZOoXkwuTyyhYqNavxuRytErxw-RSMNRRYujI5KKNc7NTIod3JBHbRUkUDJ32p6h0oXgfKQw8xU5FdIytp5PJhXefjn9UK53GMg3PV6DvER8_ilxe_g8AAP__Cn9jhg)
## Russia Warns of 'Fatal Consequences'
[The Kremlin warned the United States](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGvpSAQRn8NdmMQELWg2MbubbulGXG8zj4EI6i5_35zt37N13zJycn58zV9IQeOr9-4kytrmtAXvmmyYECZyVSLW4kU6Ypc0zVdK40adLW5dtWK1k7LuSOvm9mTb1s7KG_RDLPsK3ZKKiOtNLJvrRzqfh76xppuMYPGAaUwkhYu6az_Jo5lozW8001n7dNeBbeVcmShfwk1CjU-z1P7OPvPKdT4QQs1SvsZLdT4fdIeOMKDZ8zwYN44vkqKkFZYsWCAnbPH4K-AhVOEkiBQge8333BlgitDvo4jMC3wEB4pZuCYeSE4r5wZ663soTrdcjwcAmfbCSNfO3L4L1x-rHc79S8AAP__Orpzxw) Monday that it could face "fatal consequences" if it allows Ukraine to use U.S.-supplied weapons against targets inside Russia. The warning comes after the White House authorized Ukraine to use U.S.-supplied weapons to defend the city of Kharkiv, near the Russian border. A Russian official emphasized that Putin's warning [shouldn't be taken lightly](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtygzAQAL9GdGKEOAsoVKShc9qUzCEO-xIhOXqYyd9nnDo_sLuzH9fliuw53N7xIFv2uKAr_KTFSJAaFmg2uxNp6huy3dANFwV66pu7XTuHw4Bm070B160jKgc9jQYIVq3Ghq1WGpRRoMaLUVM7rtPYGRg2mHqcUAlQtHGJqf2MHMqddv8Tn5RaF4_G23spjyz6N6FnoefzPNtH9FzYxZaq0DOmws6T0HOqOTPKE1PIMu5yx4JeuhgyfVcKjrLEG3LIRdYsXwp5cHboXfVYOAbJQdavhBxeuCbZ7XGy95zNIEDdDmT_F1X-PfS0-jcAAP__GttrOQ). _" They underestimate the seriousness of the rebuff they may receive."_
## Dr. Pepper Ties Pepsi for No. 2
Dr. Pepper is now tied with Pepsi-Cola as the [number two carbonated soft drink](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOszAQhJ_GdButF8dA4eJv3OVvr0QOXoe9IxhhH1He_sTV10wxI40-fR-38RZkkfXxPzzZ1ZTHMFU5eLRggMxomugSM3HbsNOd7q5oaGib2SV77ROT1diS1rrFjvqJycQupRiZG3GEZNCiwf5qcbj096HX1nTRDG0YAiqDHKXm_fKZZa0zp-WdD94vU342i5tr3Ypq_ynyivz63nKp56TIn8eKPNoztCJ__y6ycimKfNxh423jHapwgZfU-SyKQMo71JlhzUBQcgxw51nWCFP-YkW-2V3cXrIsUmynDD6eQZZfmPqnmcPRTwAAAP__yRVj5g) brand in America behind Coke, according to sales data from Beverage Digest. Consumer surveys showed that Gen Z and Hispanic customers have responded to the 139-year-old soda brand's introduction of new and unusual flavors like strawberries and cream. In 2004, Dr. Pepper was tied with Sprite in sixth place. The brand says that [a consistent marketing plan](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGPrCAURn8NdtcgMKIFxZv3Yjev3dIgXMa7UTDAaubfb2br7b58pzk5H4_5YWmj-PxvdzQ1pNm6SifOPSgQalaNNwFRoGzQdLrTN67EKJvV6NANKLvFazd0ahkX7Ra99Fr2PowDDw0ZwYXiPVd8uPV8bIdlHLpeaa9GaUfLmeLoqabcfiaKdcWwvdKJuXVpbzaz1noUJv8wMTExXdfV7iW-GRMTRvgqTEx7ivhiYnJpP2wkfH8-w4HHgRkqYXnvQmAL2B0zOQsFYgIBJXnLxGQz3O9dzPL1l8kpOfJM_gsUbXQIJ-a6HhAQfWmy8cdF20al10zx525p-1Gtv3Y7jfgOAAD__5hScDA) focusing on younger consumers, including college students, has propelled Dr. Pepper into second place. The beverage also gained national attention through [viral social media videos](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj71q8zAUQJ9G2mKupRvZGjSE76u3dCkldDL6uYpV5Cg4io3fvqRz13PgwLmcx7NNOd2u73YmU2MZra9ppVEd8CBwRB5MJBIkOZm2a7sjoNCSTyZAb3vSEDV6cXTeyRgVBuE8tUHGyJMRIBAUIPRHBbrpne5bhV1ALa22wBAopFqW5rukW50o5r2stDS-zDybqdb7g8kTEwMTw7ZtzV6e9eno5V_EVj8xOaxM_o-X_ePL_ft8Sye-mHDfUs7poTqGcJ1tyr_J-uffasRPAAAA__9iX1Im) of people making a Dirty Dr Pepper, a mix of the soda and coffee creamer.

subject: Our kids (and parents) deserve better!

body:
I know that the condition of K-12 education is a critical issue for working families across our state - fortunately, this election cycle, we have a real opportunity to repair much of the damage done in recent years. | | [](http://email.sermodigital.com/ct/63252588:WXfaPkWNk:m:1:2714570852:B14E087743DC292BF3F20F4502F0EC81:r "David Olson for
Superintendent of Public Instruction")
---
|
Friends,

My name is David Olson. You may have seen my recent "Newsmaker Interview" with Shift WA. But, if you haven't, I hope you will allow me to take a quick moment and share why I am running for Washington State Superintendent of Public Instruction.

As a dedicated member of the Peninsula School District Board of Directors for over a decade, I've worked hard to bring positive change to public schools in my district. Now I'm on a mission to improve K-12 education across our state. Here's a glimpse of my vision and priorities:

**Why I'm Running:** I am motivated by deep concerns about the current administration under Chris Reykdal and the need for a more collaborative relationship between the Office of Superintendent of Public Instruction (OSPI) and local school boards. OSPI should support our locally elected school boards - not dictate to them - because they know what's best for their community.

**Top Priorities:** My goals include pushing for fair funding, getting parents back involved with curriculum, fully supporting special education, and addressing chronic absenteeism by engaging parents and communities more effectively. But more than anything else, I want to refocus our schools on teaching kids how to read and write and pass their math classes.

**Overcoming Challenges:** We need strong leadership at OSPI. I advocate for a return to rigorous, science-based curricula and giving more control back to local school boards.

**Successful Policies:** In my district, we successfully banned social media and cell phones in schools, leading to less stress and better engagement among students. I aim to replicate such successes statewide.

I know that the condition of K-12 education is a critical issue for working families across our state - fortunately, this election cycle, we have a real opportunity to repair much of the damage done in recent years.

This campaign is about making a real difference for our state's children and their future. To achieve this, I am reaching out to ask for your financial support. _**[Your contribution, no matter the size, will make a significant impact on our efforts to bring much-needed change to Washington's educational system.](http://email.sermodigital.com/ct/63252589:WXfaPkWNk:m:1:2714570852:B14E087743DC292BF3F20F4502F0EC81:r)**_

_**[Please consider donating today to support our campaign and help us transform education in our state.](http://email.sermodigital.com/ct/63252589:WXfaPkWNk:m:1:2714570852:B14E087743DC292BF3F20F4502F0EC81:r)**_

Thank you for your support,

David Olson
Candidate for Washington State Superintendent of Public Instruction

I just met with my Finance Director, Katelyn, over a cup of coffee to talk about our fundraising and she had some not so great news... we are pacing behind on our goal. Our upcoming statewide reporting deadline is in two weeks, and if our numbers are weak that will leave an opening for our MAGA opponent, Kelly Ayotte. = | | = | | = | = | | = | = | | = Right now, our campaign is in a dead heat against Republican Kelly Ayotte in the polls. We knew this would be a tough race, but the ratings from the Cook Political Report confirmed it: Democrats will have to give it our all if we want to flip this toss-up seat. Now that Kelly Ayotte has endorsed Donald Trump for President, the MAGA donors are in full force to help them both flip New Hampshire bright red. But I feel confident that if we meet our fundraising goals, we have the message and the team to build a strong operation that can elect Democrats up and down the ballot come November. = | = | | = | = | | = | = | | = Thank you, your support means so much. \- Joyce | = | = = Joyce Craig for NH PO Box 3893 Manchester, NH 03105 United States | mailto:info@joycecraig.org Paid for by Joyce Craig for NH. The battle for the heart of our nation is winnable. But I can’t do it alone. I need you. Can you help?

body:
Day of Days - June 6th, 1944

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/f6ac8b13b4ba/n41kepo7ku-12698459?e=25844e23a8)
https://ne.gop/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=2f73dfa212-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-2f73dfa212-21732365

** Good Morning Republicans,
------------------------------------------------------------
Ephesians 1:7 He is so rich in kindness and grace that he purchased our freedom with the blood of his Son and forgave our sins.
June 6th, 1944; D-Day (https://www.history.com/topics/world-war-ii/d-day?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=2f73dfa212-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-2f73dfa212-21732365) ...The Day of Days.

D-Day was the name given to the June 6, 1944, invasion of the beaches at Normandy in northern France by troops from the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and other countries during World War II. France at the time was occupied by the armies of Nazi Germany, and the amphibious assault—codenamed Operation Overlord—landed some 156,000 Allied soldiers on the beaches of Normandy by the end of the day.

Despite their success, some 4,000 Allied troops were killed by German soldiers defending the beaches. At the time, the D-Day invasion was the largest naval, air and land operation in history, and within a few days about 326,000 troops, more than 50,000 vehicles and some 100,000 tons of equipment had landed. By August 1944, all of northern France had been liberated, and in spring of 1945 the Allies had defeated the Germans. Historians often refer to D-Day as the beginning of the end of World War II.
80 years is over four generations ago and I think most Americans would say our country has DRAMATICALLY changed. From the Revolutionary War to present conflicts...have current generations lived our lives knowing, respecting, honoring that our freedom was purchased with blood?
I believe in the statement that we should never forget our history or we are doomed to repeat it. When I watch documentaries like "Band of Brothers" or movies like "Saving Private Ryan", although given heightened drama for the effect, many of the characters are based on real soldiers, real Americans. As a student of human nature, I find myself drawn to the leaders and their habits or boldness as much as the historical timelines.
What made the soldiers who they were?
What culture molded them into having the strength and courage to mentally and emotionally push through hardships?
What culture molded a Nation into a level of Patriotism that they Pledge Allegiance to the Flag and MEANT it?
I believe that we are at a tipping point for our country.
If we hold each other accountable to the human rights of life, liberty and pursuit of happiness, if we respect the wisdom of our Founding Fathers governmental creation/experiment, if we truly honor the sacrifices and HISTORY of the people of this great nation...we might just be able to make America GREAT again.
But it will take ALL of us agreeing to one set of Principles, we must value each other, and believe in a VISION to further our principles with in our communities.

------------------------------------------------------------
Statewide, we have made unprecedented changes to the culture of our Republican Party and other States seek to learn from us. From YOU! We are leaders in an America First movement. You have been measured, persistent, consistent, and striving to better yourselves everyday in this political landscape.
You have brought STABILITY to this party.
And I can guarantee you one thing...there HAS been an Awakening. This movement is built on People First. This is the area that I am most proud of and genuinely enjoy with my job as Chairman. Working together and watching the State and the vast majority of County Parties put the People First. More people, bringing more people, like a ripple in a pond and the numbers prove the results. Double the number of County Delegates attended this year's County Conventions. We've got more active parties and HUGE turnouts to county meetings all across Nebraska. We are just scratching the surface of the potential within Nebraska's grassroots.
My focus through the Summertime is to continue to build the relationships for our party to achieve it's objectives. We will be developing our 2025 Legislative Plan, providing candidate and campaign schools, hosting parlimentarian training, establishing Days-of-Action for candidates as well as county voter registration activities. We will spend every moment possible making the in-person contacts to the voters of Nebraska.
I will be working at the National level to bring more influence and spotlight to our efforts for real solutions of securing our elections, protecting women's sports & spaces, education, tax reform, energy independence, immigration, etc. I feel fortunate that our relationships are growing with many of the leaders within our party from President Trump's Team to Turning Point, Patriot organizations and our many Nebraska coalitions.
I will be traveling to Detroit - June 15th to speak at The People's Convention hosted by Turning Point Action. I will be detailing the "politics" of Nebraska, speaking to the amazing efforts of the grassroots of Nebraska, encouraging attendees on the basics of grassroots organizations (Show up, Know the Rules, Achieve an Objective), and finalize the timeline for Winner-Take-All legislation. I'll update on how to watch this awesome 3-day event in next week's newsletter.

http://tpaction.com/peoples?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=2f73dfa212-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-2f73dfa212-21732365
It is a new day in Nebraska Politics especially for the Republican Party. This party has returned to serving its membership (The People), who support the objectives of the party, and the principles with which we represent. We have to STAND firm and not bow to the Liberal agendas because we don't want to hurt peoples feelings. We HAVE strong values that resonate with most Nebraskans. Folks, our challenges are not new and they are not unattainable. But they will require everyone in our party to see the Big Picture and work towards it together day-by-day. I believe that Nebraskans see the Big Picture when it comes to the immediate challenges we face as a State.
✅We have to fix Nebraska's broken property tax system
✅We have to prioritize election honesty that uses common sense and transparency of voting - Election Accountability and Voter Verification.
✅We have to grow our economy through job creation and education of work identities
✅We have to strengthen and maintain the amazing rural communities and modernize the infrastructures
✅We have to support our agricultural system, the lifeblood of Nebraska's economy
✅We have to restore educational basics, safety of classrooms, and the excellence of Nebraska values, so our kids take ownership of the Nebraska Good Life and stay IN Nebraska.
✅We have to bring respect to Law and Order and address the rising mental health concerns that can easily start in supporting healthy families.
DONATE (https://ne.gop/donate/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=2f73dfa212-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-2f73dfa212-21732365) to the NEGOP. DONATE to your local GOP.
We will put your dollars to work connecting to more Republican voters state-wide.
We will put your dollars to work defeating Democrats at the local level.

We have plenty of work to do with Legislation Support, support of candidates, connecting to coalition partners, event planning, and discussing the different committee's and groups need to be successful in 2024!
The truth shall set us free.
Blessings,
–Chairman Underwood

| _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3d5c62e1-665f-4d8e-917c-b434f8e99928/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._

---
| | | | | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tca085b5e-82fb-479a-ae48-e053e3728ccc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter, my motto has always been that when you love this country, you fight for the people who make it work. That's what I'm doing every day in the Senate. I'm fighting for the Dignity of Work. No matter where you're from or what kind of work you do, hard work should pay off for everyone. Whether you punch a clock or swipe a badge, earn a salary or make tips, are raising children or caring for an aging parent, I'll fight for you. I'm fighting for accountability. For years, we've seen corporations lobby for tax breaks and bad trade deals that hurt workers. I'm not afraid to stand up to Wall Street or take on Big Pharma to level the playing field. I'm fighting for our fundamental rights. My opponent has made it clear he doesn’t have our best interests at heart. I will always fight for a more equal and inclusive country. It's official. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will address a joint session of U.S. Congress on June 13. Below is the letter bearing the signatures of all four Congressional leaders who formally invited him last week.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=145282317&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ1MjgyMzE3LCJpYXQiOjE3MTc1MDY1NDIsImV4cCI6MTcyMDA5ODU0MiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.wtXGYfDAv46bwfU8h6u0Lpl3BfeRWxv6niCXRwoUXZg)
This will be Netanyahu's fourth address to a joint session of Congress (1996, 2011, 2015). And while there have been more than 100 such joint sessions addressed by foreign leaders, you'd be hard pressed to find an invitation to an accused war criminal like Benjamin Netanyahu.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9ac30320-0232-43a4-a521-b7fcca28312a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Here's what to expect as American leadership proudly invites a man credibly accused of war crimes. Prime Minister Netanyahu will spend his remarks undermining peace and justice by spewing misinformation and disinformation about his policies and the Palestinian people. Netanyahu's lies will span at least five areas.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..FBrALFKnW2mANAWDBkneHoOMikh3BjyfTGQgZ8zxllw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145282317)
### **1\. Lies about the origins of this siege on Gaza**
Netanyahu will claim all was well on 10/6, and Hamas attacked Israel without warning or cause--other than their hatred of Jewish people. As [I've written before](https://substack.com/redirect/8d04bf8e-6c09-4274-ae68-e0677384c2cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), we cannot understand 10/7 unless we first recognize the ground reality leading up to 10/7. Netanyahu will ignore those ground realities.
For example, Netanyahu will ignore Israel's 57 year illegal military occupation of Palestinian territories for the illegal act it is. He will ignore that Hamas is not an ancient organization, but having been [established only in 1987](https://substack.com/redirect/785cfaa2-a94d-4b4b-ac96-044deca89069?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), it is a _reaction_ to more than 20 years of illegal occupation and land grab. And he will ignore Israel's 700,000 illegal settlements as the violation of international human rights law that they are, as repeatedly affirmed by the United Nations and the United States.
Netanyahu will _also_ ignore that that two decades of Israel's land, air, and sea blockades on Gaza left people desperate and distressed, and [violates international human rights law](https://substack.com/redirect/c6296b5e-10cc-4b7b-ba5b-ed3ecce3859c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). He will ingore that some 9500 Palestinians are indefinitely detained in Israeli prison in what is known as _administrative detention_ , many without charge or opportunity for release. And he will ignore that as you read this, up to 1000 Palestinian children are indefinitely detained in Israeli prison, again without charge, under so-called _administrative detention_.
Likewise, Netanyahu will ignore that in the year prior to 10/7 the Israeli military [killed at least 240 Palestinian civilians in the West Bank](https://substack.com/redirect/0a2e5a9f-5597-4d2b-8fd1-77dfcce60083?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--death toll included 47 children--and in fact was the deadliest year in recent history for Palestinian civilians.
Finally, Netanyahu will ignore that [he deliberately propped up Hamas for years](https://substack.com/redirect/e6456dd3-c4fc-4f2d-a797-35fc7e05d025?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with the specific goal to undermine Palestinian statehood, regional security, and empowerment of the people of Palestine.
In short, Netanyahu will attempt to paint Hamas' war crime attack on civilians on 10/7 as a spontaneous attack out of the blue--without any of the above history of Israeli war crimes. Don't let him get away with that false narrative.
### **2\. Lies about his policies during this siege on Gaza**
Netanyahu will claim Israel is the "most moral Army in the world," and will lie about his policies in Gaza. He will ignore the ICJ's documented lawsuit accusing Israel of genocide, and proving intent with the very words of Israeli leadership seeking full and total destruction of Gaza and replacement of Palestinians. He will ignore the ICC's detailed accusations against him and his Defense Minister, Gallant, for indiscriminately bombing civilians in Palestine. He will ignore that the New York Times and NBC have documented more than 200 instances where the Israeli military forced Palestinians into a confirmed "safe zone," only to bomb that very safe zone, killing thousands of innocent civilians. And he will attempt to make the bombings of civilians, journalists, aid workers, and children seem like they were honest mistakes.
They were not honest mistakes. They were deliberate war crimes, and it is critical we do not fall for this continued gaslighting.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c7544783-0238-46a6-ace8-6cbb835a9b99?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Credit: Ayman via MSNBC
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..FBrALFKnW2mANAWDBkneHoOMikh3BjyfTGQgZ8zxllw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145282317)
### **3\. Lies about the International Criminal Court (ICC)**
Netanyahu will claim the ICC is making an equivalence between Israel and Hamas--a meritless claim the ICC has already thoroughly debunked. But meanwhile, Netanyahu will ignore that [Israel has illegally spied on the ICC for the past nine years](https://substack.com/redirect/840c2a59-b469-4527-ae53-84deb5a5ec72?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and aggressively attempted to bribe and intimidate the previous and current ICC Prosecutor. Netanyahu will claim the ICC has no jurisdiction over Israel, ignoring that [Palestine has been a member state of the ICC since April 1, 2015](https://substack.com/redirect/a812b2dc-8dd0-4ebb-900f-6d0f1c830b8a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Therefore, the ICC has jurisdiction over war crimes committed in Palestine--which Israel has committed.
The ICC, like the ICJ, is working in accordance with the rules of international human rights law, and their authority must be respected if we truly claim "no one is above the law."
### **4\. Lies about how this conflict can be resolved**
Netanyahu will claim "all that needs to happen for this war to end is for Hamas to release the hostages." But we know this is false, as even the current offer President Biden announced is one Netanyahu himself rejected less than an hour later--specifically because Netanyahu wants to continue to bomb Gaza indiscriminately.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/617fffdf-a7d3-406b-ba4a-4aa26d2a89f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
CNN likewise [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/b878998e-2bd4-46b1-9f1b-6784485f69b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "Less than an hour after Biden detailed the Israeli proposal, Netanyahu's office insisted Israel would not end the war until Hamas is defeated & "all its goals are achieved." Moreover, the very families of hostages are now openly accusing Netanyahu of giving up on the hostages, unless it can benefit him personally. Netanyahu won't agree to hostage release deal unless it polls well for him, [Israeli families say they were told](https://substack.com/redirect/af429ad6-d800-4a81-866c-6b7809a38222?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), adding, "The Israeli government made a conscious and deliberate decision to sacrifice the hostages," the Hostage Family Forum said.
This conflict will truly resolve with a permanent and lasting ceasefire, an unconditional release of all hostages from both sides, an end to Israel's military occupation of Palestine, an end to Israel's illegal settlements in Palestine, an end to Israel's illegal blockade of Gaza, a sovereign Palestinian state, a prosecution of all war crimes in front of the ICC, and a rebuilding of Gaza and the West Bank.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..FBrALFKnW2mANAWDBkneHoOMikh3BjyfTGQgZ8zxllw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145282317)
### **5\. Lies about his critics**
Netanyahu will likely lean heavily into claiming criticism of him, of the Israeli government, and of how Israel has conducted its bombing of Gaza is all rooted in antisemitism. While antisemitism must never be tolerated, condemning war crimes is not antisemitism--it is pro justice. Incidentally, on a recent hike in rural Colorado I came across this sticker at a rest stop.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0b00ed2b-00e9-4865-938d-9609b035bba1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It should shock the conscience that in addition to banning journalists altogether, the [Israeli government has killed more than 108 journalists and media workers](https://substack.com/redirect/04e569c3-3083-4923-b323-5b3ab1a14ccc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) reporting from inside Gaza. Indeed, it is no wonder [that numerous Jewish organizations](https://substack.com/redirect/e75bd9d2-b32f-41e7-9b63-fc69303f8083?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are loudly condemning Netanyahu's injustices, rejecting the claims of antisemitism, and demanding justice for Palestine.
**In conclusion,** this is not an exhaustive list, but I'd be surprised if Netanyahu does not at least touch on all five of these at some point, among others, during his June 13th address. It is a shame that American political leadership has made a bipartisan commitment to invite a credibly accused war criminal to address a joint session of Congress. Doing so does nothing to benefit the American people, further harms Palestinians, and does not make Israel any safer. One thing is for sure, however, that this invitation has emphatically debunked the claim that the United States is committed to an international rules based order.
And that reality is devastating for the prospect of international peace and justice.

| | | | | **Youngkin: We Need An All-American Energy Plan**
**ICYMI:** Governor Glenn Youngkin joined fellow Republican governors in Louisiana this week to call for an all-American energy plan to strengthen America's economy and our national security.

"It's constantly presented to the American people that this is an 'or' moment - that you actually can't reduce the carbon footprint and embrace an all-of-the-above, all-American energy plan," **Youngkin said.** "And the short answer is: we, in fact, must embrace an all-American, all-of-the-above energy plan."

| Youngkin's remarks come as [he _sent a letter_](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=da191e377e942801e00b0f4b7bcd99e2584e04a9c2ae9829fc229fd17e841d354accdc92143fd0f5b30c53b4d60725ed0ee8af99d04e6ecffa06fdccca04f051 "he sent a letter") with his fellow Republican governors to President Joe Biden criticizing the White House for hampering American energy, and calling on the Biden Administration to reverse course and unleash American energy.

"In addition to increased grocery, gas, and utility expenses for Americans, these actions have empowered rather than countered our adversaries to direct the global energy conversation. Failing to maintain the American energy advantage emboldens China and Russia and creates a national security threat for both Americans and our allies abroad," the governors write in their letter. "To address these concerns, we call on you to pause the rhetorical and regulatory hostility towards traditional energy and to include states as active participants in further rulemaking. Secondly, we call on your administration to allow the free markets to flow and adopt an all-of-the-above homegrown energy plan, which includes traditional and renewable energy sources."

During his remarks, Governor Youngkin said the Biden Administration's energy policies are driving America closer to China and further away from American energy dominance.

[](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=dac0035a198146a3a4147dea0beb7ffd&_e=wrm98FZkzv8zABNF3kZaVh7F_g_X6jf8sFMSZN4wv_FMG95dGZ5g5TlFk4lY_8kde2hxKOvjbw0xpbLFlmS2N9cN9cFqw7viYeJdq2XbN5fMFDC-JH41e23R5mQEgJgxUzq_qEYfm-OxtRPc6y3wnpuG33peZRtfjXJ0tt4zPixiKidF2q-17ewSB7zFIcBLb1_IU49QnbMSElB6nRtcahZKyDJ1JpBXOQwcu88i3M0IUT6ca9gSm0TxnXYbVExfMOJCyvKC9Pk-E60DVZbOkA%3D%3D)
I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important le ssons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state.

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.

From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.

Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.

As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as _"Wyoming's doctor,"_ but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be.

**_Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations._**

As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state. **[But it will require strong leadership, a clear vision, and your continued support.](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=dac0035a198146a3a4147dea0beb7ffd&_e=wrm98FZkzv8zABNF3kZaVh7F_g_X6jf8sFMSZN4wv_FMG95dGZ5g5TlFk4lY_8kde2hxKOvjbw0xpbLFlmS2N9cN9cFqw7viYeJdq2XbN5fMFDC-JH41e23R5mQEgJgxXipewQ6l_eCbJq7fyfIP0yd0Wg12ntCT_IYXmjF7-DSvhzveYQVkwB5GtZpqA4z-Cmr5XdJqeB-qxUV8eVUI1rPwTBScEX6DntagBueR8RdeXAeCoC6ZccryB8-lZJkVkd67wLbLMEIkfmEkNWL7kw%3D%3D)**

Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families.

Sincerely,
Senator John Barrasso [CHIP IN FOR A STRONG WYOMING](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=dac0035a198146a3a4147dea0beb7ffd&_e=wrm98FZkzv8zABNF3kZaVh7F_g_X6jf8sFMSZN4wv_FMG95dGZ5g5TlFk4lY_8kde2hxKOvjbw0xpbLFlmS2N9cN9cFqw7viYeJdq2XbN5fMFDC-JH41e23R5mQEgJgxxfgySFhNfnmn4hla3Zr0F-7hIfo7NwIpqOk4rM1_BHxJ27XevyUIpcnRPvJRo_accceGXn65HXleyZYTj4-3KhlLRGP_34PzNffIRgMB8h_jikkI4tLABDYCXh2aTiya7Qhoe7C04HgLKySjHZ2NWA%3D%3D)

name: Matt Diemer
subject: Happy Pride Month!
body:
| |
---
Peter, I just wanted to take a minute to recognize Pride Month. Pride Month to me is the acknowledgment of the struggle from the LGBTQIA+ community for their liberty in the USA. Liberty is at the forefront of this great American experiment, a grand melting pot of people, religions, ethnicities, languages, cultures, and ideas. To have liberty, you must have the freedom to explore who you are and embrace the person you discover in that exploration. That's the beauty of America: we have created a society that allows you that exploration. Pride Month is an acknowledgment of the struggle of the LGBTQIA+ community to find who they really are and to gain society's acknowledgment of their true selves. In America, we must remember that not all people will be the same, nor should we expect them to be. We must encourage and embrace individuals and their unique contributions to the United States, celebrating the differences that contribute to a truly great nation. Happy Pride!

body:
I’m writing to you because Kari Lake was recently endorsed by Josh Hawley, the Senator from Missouri.
#

Peter, this is retired Capitol Police Staff Sergeant and U.S. Army Veteran Aquilino Gonell.
I’m writing to you because Kari Lake was recently endorsed by Josh Hawley, the Senator from Missouri.
Yes, this Josh Hawley:
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-june24.NmHAEe&refcode=em240604-1-160&t=1&akid=2406%2E734936%2EEYgpq9)
The same guy who riled up Trump’s mob before they stormed the Capitol, and the same guy who ran for his life while my fellow officers and I risked our lives to protect everyone, including Hawley.
We stood our ground and fought for our lives against the mob. They sided against the Constitution yet they claimed to support the rule of law and the police.
This is the type of person Kari Lake wants in her corner.
As for me, I’m proud to be in Ruben’s corner.
While we fought the insurrectionists that day, Ruben supported his colleagues on the House floor. He was ready to fight, too.
He’s going to fight every day to defeat Kari Lake and make sure there is no home for insurrectionists in the Senate.
That’s more than enough for me. If you’re with Ruben and can’t wait to put an end to Kari Lake’s political ambitions, please:

body:
When elected, I will fight to secure the southern border, protect our constitutional rights, and defend liberty at all costs... | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/rickbecker2024/campaignannouncement-17379460?e=d842fb25cc)

[](https://rickbecker2024.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=3700284ea8&e=d842fb25cc)
| Peter,

**We are officially ONE WEEK AWAY from Election Day!**

America’s future is on the ballot next week, and Team Becker needs all the support we can get!

As the Trump candidate in this race, I will get to work on day one to secure the southern border, fight for American energy independence, defend our constitutional rights, and take America back.

We cannot afford to send spineless RINOs to Washington who will join the corrupt political establishment the second they’re sworn in — we need America-First proven conservative fighters who will work with President Donald Trump to get the job done.

Since announcing my America-First campaign for Congress, I have received endorsements from National Leaders, North Dakota Leaders, and organizations that share my commitment to defending the Constitution, promoting individual liberty, and taking our country back!
---
[](https://rickbecker2024.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=ec87901796&e=d842fb25cc)
[](https://rickbecker2024.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=cf471c2350&e=d842fb25cc)
[](https://rickbecker2024.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=174ba487bd&e=d842fb25cc)
| While I am proud of the endorsements I have received, it is your voice that I will represent when elected to Congress. I am running a grassroots campaign because We The People have been ignored for far too long.

The Biden administration's failure to secure our southern border has led to a surge in illegal immigration, with thousands of individuals crossing over daily and an estimated _**7 million illegal immigrants entering**_ since Joe Biden took office.

We have gun-grabbing Democrats and spineless RINOs in Congress who refuse to stand up and fight for our Second Amendment rights.

The Second Amendment serves as a critical check against the potential for government tyranny and ensures that the American people have the means to protect themselves, their families, and their property.
**That’s why Team Becker held our Gun Giveaway, and I am proud to announce that Mark Splonskowski from Bismarck is the official winner!**
---
[](https://rickbecker2024.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=5d4d31061f&e=d842fb25cc)
| Team Becker has been hard at work knocking on doors, speaking with voters, and mobilizing our fight to take America back.

Your voice matters, and it’s time that We The People are represented in Washington.

This Friday, I invite you to join me at the Avalon Events Center in Fargo for a Campaign Rally before you cast your vote next Tuesday.

I will be joining candidate for State Representative Jared Hendrix to discuss my plan to work with President Donald J. Trump to secure the border, combat Biden’s inflation, and save our country.

There will be live music by Jeff Oddem and fellow patriots from across the state who share my vision for America.
**The event kicks off at 5:00 PM and is free to attend. Click below to RSVP today.**

body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
In case you missed it this weekend, my friend sent me [this video](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) from my old neighborhood in Superior, CO (Rock Creek). This is at the home of one of the CU Regents in order to pressure her to get CU to divest from Israel. In this block normally filled with children playing, pro-Palestine agitators had "wanted" posters with the CU Regents picture, blocked traffic and called for "intifada." The Mayor told her there's nothing they could do.
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, June 4, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Ballots to begin hitting mailstream today for June 25 primary election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Ballots will begin [hitting the mailstream today](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), June 3, in the state's primary election, Secretary of State Jena Griswold has announced. Election Day is Tuesday, June 25.
"Ballots are arriving to your mailbox soon," said Griswold, in a [press release](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). "There is still time to register to vote if you have not already, and I encourage every eligible Coloradan to do so."
Active voters must be mailed a ballot by Friday, June 7. The ballot will include [party-related ballot items and a special election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to select what has been termed a "placeholder" in Colorado's 4th Congressional District, completing the unexpired term of U.S. Rep. Ken Buck. In that election, there will be a choice of a Democrat, Republican and two minor-party candidates for the unexpired term.
While all voters will be eligible to participate in the [4th District special election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), they will otherwise only be able to participate in their party of choice's primary or select a primary as an unaffiliated voter. Minor party voters in the 4th District whose party is not holding a primary election will receive a ballot featuring only the special election.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Special district elections: RTD board will have elections to eight district seats](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Rocky Mountain Voice reader Chuck O'Reilly has launched a project to shed light on [non-partisan local elections](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), focusing on processes and candidate information for positions on councils, school districts, and special district boards.
* He provides detailed insights into the importance of these roles in [managing substantial community budgets](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), noting that 70% of his property taxes fund non-partisan entities like school and fire districts.
* The project also outlines the candidacy process for significant roles like the [Regional Transportation District (RTD) Board](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), offering guidance on navigating the complex steps involved.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[State income tax credit for college tuition will cost Colorado $38M annually](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE CENTER SQUARE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado has enacted a [refundable state income tax credit](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to help cover tuition for students at higher education institutions, with an annual fiscal impact of about $38 million.
* Students [eligible for the credit](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) must have graduated from a Colorado high school within two years, have a household income under $90,000, enroll in at least six credit hours, and maintain a GPA of 2.5 or above.
* The law mandates reporting by the [Department of Higher Education](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on the program's eligibility and impact, with the first report due by January 31, 2026.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Proposed Denver slaughterhouse ban could cost Colorado economy up to $861M, study shows](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Denver voters will decide in November on a ballot measure to [ban slaughterhouses in the city](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), a move that could potentially cost the Colorado economy up to $861 million and impact nearly 3,000 jobs.
* Colorado State University's study predicts [severe economic impacts](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) including a significant reduction in the state's lamb slaughtering capacity and job losses ranging from 697 to 2,787 depending on various scenarios.
* The measure, proposed by[ Pro-Animal Future](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), cites concerns over neighborhood nuisances, workplace injuries, and psychological harms to workers, aiming to transition towards more humane and sustainable food production methods.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Trump says trial, conviction'very hard' on wife Melania](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE HILL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Former President Trump stated that his recent trial and conviction in New York have been [particularly distressing for his wife](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), Melania, given the public discussion of his alleged infidelity.
* In a "Fox and Friends" interview, Trump criticized the media and legal processes for using salacious details, claiming they [worsen the situation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for him and his family.
* He mentioned coping with the possibility of prison, with his [sentencing set for July 11](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Zorn: Colorado's passenger rail romance vs. reality](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY RYAN ZORN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)| COMMENTARY
_Have you noticed that the expansion of passenger rail is beginning to permeate agendas of state and local governments? The romance of big rail projects and access to other people 's money have always been hard for career politicians to resist._
_Gov. Jared Polis is no different. The Biden administration is dangling billions of federal taxpayer dollars out for grabs. Here at home, the governor just secured a legislated $3 per-day rental car fee worth $58 million per year and a privately-negotiated political ransom worth $175 million per year from Colorado oil and gas producers in the form of new production fees that will be funneled toward new passenger rail initiatives. _
__
_His message to our local governments seems to be "all aboard!" or get out of the way. However, his aspiration to make passenger rail mainstream in Colorado is totally separated from economic reality for families, woefully misjudging the feasibility of such an option for the viability of local businesses in rural Colorado, and will misallocate dollars that could have been spent elsewhere to reduce significantly greater amounts of greenhouse gas emissions._

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Devotional: What type of dog are you?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | JUNE 3** _Using your imagination and curiosity is one of life 's greatest joys when used in a healthy way. I invite you to think about something fun: "What type of dog are you most like?"_
**[In Boebert-less 4th District debate, Republican Rumble still centered on Boebert](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER** **| STATE | JUNE 2** _A brief heated exchange between Deborah Flora and Richard Holtorf highlighted what otherwise was a 4th District congressional debate which seemed to center on everything but those appearing on stage Saturday during the Republican Rumble here at the Grizzly Rose._
**[Evans, Flora win Republican Rumble straw poll; LP chair second to Lopez in special election poll](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER**** | STATE | JUNE 1** _Deborah Flora captured another straw poll win Saturday on the eve of primary ballots beginning to populate mail boxes across the district and the state._ __
__**[Evans positions as a'big tent' option in 8th District during Rumble with opponent Janak Joshi](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | JUNE 1** _Gabe Evans appeared Saturday to walk the walk. "I'm going to work as a big-tent Republican," Evans said. "That is how we win the 8th Congressional District."_

Reply to this email (or reach out to [brian@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:brian@rockymountainvoice.com?subject=Contributor%20Interest%20\(via%20Mountain%20Minute\)) or send us a message on social media to chat!
|

| Greater Georgia Newsletter June 4, 2024
School is out and vacations are underway - but the team at Greater Georgia is spending our summer hard at work, laser-focused on growing our state's conservative movement ahead of November.
Primary season is officially over. As of today, we're exactly five months out until the general election. From our perspective, that means there are five months left to grow our base and share the conservative message - targeting key voting blocs and building new coalitions to drive victories up and down the ballot.
Our update below focuses on just some of the events we've held so far this summer, along with a preview of our upcoming initiatives.

# Fox News: Biden's abortion script flipped by businesswoman's boost to pro-life groups
May 23, 2024
In case you missed it, Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler was featured in Fox News last month - where she gave an exclusive interview about her six-figure donation to pro-faith and pro-family groups across Georgia. She spoke about the role that the Left's abortion-on-demand agenda will play in this year's general election, and why the conservative movement must continue to take a strong stand for life. Click [HERE](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Gn4ATVuQgYwBY2ztuwFgnstP8tFztw1Ijrxk6Uz003wxHrUqg8YhoG0gz7ARZiVMgrt_pxZN_Bfk9xMCtrSEuHlFbltrkFuCz4Ppe-qZzUiCe40E9bOw7DtUxP3FXBtBIXnSIm4TR3lY2oLeB1ximhkkkuB3nVSuQcklLA62d1I7KtV5L2ntXiDLBiPUFEtLvpNaEIhD3yGrKx830ENlehpqsYoRGZsQvrcpgTe3hqFYwMpmNN8zWwudyYCNF6M9DK62VA11vnvMADhDDhcszA==&c=nF4Td5Or1d_kE0ju2-AOkY2Psulyc3K3xmLc2UeT_7PYt6nsd6wg5g==&ch=wGEPPbnrc7KcydrJ2lF1xjqoRaYSGWRu9SdzORcJlnZ1TF8JvS_biw==) to read the full article, or read excerpts below:
"We care about the direction of the economy. We care about the border being closed. We care about crime needing to go down. We care about our kids needing to be able to read by third grade. All these things, and Democrats have been left with making it a single-issue race because they've failed on every single other policy," she said.
"The more money the Biden-Harris campaign spends on their pro-abortion campaign, the further they fall in the polls. So, it's going to be interesting. It's going to be very dynamic. But I think we can be confident that the things that we are for are the advancement of the human condition and not ending the human condition."

Washington Examiner: Georgia Republicans Plot 2024 Comeback with Trump's Appeal to Black Voters May 17, 2024
Last month, Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler was featured in the Washington Examiner \- which highlighted Greater Georgia and its efforts to engage the black community ahead of November. The article covered Kelly's appearance at the Georgia GOP State Convention, where she joined Fox News Commentator Leo Terrell and WSB Radio Host Shelley Wynter for a fireside chat about the New Conservative Coalition. Click [HERE](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Gn4ATVuQgYwBY2ztuwFgnstP8tFztw1Ijrxk6Uz003wxHrUqg8YhoG0gz7ARZiVMLAfXz4Z8Kib3NExztmINRGw7JKvS52lzPl46RAqrqRqYYl3c9TFXTzAFP1veQxEoPS-wIXBhkYJi_Rda_SG1vKIJM8OOr6ZfEgEa8naaqfhjEv75-KNoSGY7axjRUE-ajJ0kj2uFClenUXZrQBIFDGUhFa8ZvFP5olCf9zV5vNMUKnK5luqw-ljUH309tgfOek-4dZctNmr7H5Wiseis4g==&c=nF4Td5Or1d_kE0ju2-AOkY2Psulyc3K3xmLc2UeT_7PYt6nsd6wg5g==&ch=wGEPPbnrc7KcydrJ2lF1xjqoRaYSGWRu9SdzORcJlnZ1TF8JvS_biw==) to read the full article or read excerpts below:
"Kelly Loeffler may not be a U.S. senator anymore, but she hasn't strayed far from the center of Georgia politics. Loeffler made an appearance at the Georgia state GOP convention in Columbus Friday to talk about how Republicans can take back the Peach State. Flanked by conservative talk radio hosts Leo Terrell and Shelley Wynter, she hosted a "fireside chat" centered largely on how to win more black voters.
"Democrats need black voters more than black voters need the Democratic Party," said Loeffler, who served in the Senate in 2020 and 2021 before losing her seat to Sen. Raphael Warnock (D-GA). "The Trump coalition is good for voters of every color, every religion, every creed."

### Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler Applauds Signature of New Election Bills
May 7, 2024
Last month, Governor Kemp signed a package of new election integrity bills into law - all designed to enhance election security, accuracy, and transparency. The package features several key pieces of legislation including SB 189 - which codifies some of the most significant election reforms of 2024. You can read Greater Georgia's statement about the laws above, or click [HERE](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Gn4ATVuQgYwBY2ztuwFgnstP8tFztw1Ijrxk6Uz003wxHrUqg8YhoG0gz7ARZiVMGMkjOOCu-6YiGR5k_BMBBj3cBHQSIKY0l9Qk7kM34mbN6RfmGcOm29bpA8dbmpSjNJuVV9UEvtJI-D3tkmGR-h9OeDH7Vp4k8q7StHEBJqcIsUG6ic3Yto7jJ7ZvoHLYNqLP2klGdBj3pvzOuwnLfeI5GQ85PrrJKR3mR1-yIw1A7CXzINfVzXngd-rykxESpi8jKLOBhjw=&c=nF4Td5Or1d_kE0ju2-AOkY2Psulyc3K3xmLc2UeT_7PYt6nsd6wg5g==&ch=wGEPPbnrc7KcydrJ2lF1xjqoRaYSGWRu9SdzORcJlnZ1TF8JvS_biw==) to read our full press release, including a summary of the new provisions.

clean_body: | | | | == | | | Greater Georgia Newsletter June 4, 2024 School is out and vacations are underway - but the team at Greater Georgia is spending our summer hard at work, laser-focused on growing our state's conservative movement ahead of November. Primary season is officially over. As of today, we're exactly five months out until the general election. From our perspective, that means there are five months left to grow our base and share the conservative message - targeting key voting blocs and building new coalitions to drive victories up and down the ballot. Our update below focuses on just some of the events we've held so far this summer, along with a preview of our upcoming initiatives. | | | LATEST NEWS | == | Fox News: Biden's abortion script flipped by businesswoman's boost to pro-life groups May 23, 2024 In case you missed it, Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler was featured in Fox News last month - where she gave an exclusive interview about her six-figure donation to pro-faith and pro-family groups across Georgia. She spoke about the role that the Left's abortion-on-demand agenda will play in this year's general election, and why the conservative movement must continue to take a strong stand for life. Click == to read the full article, or read excerpts below: "We care about the direction of the economy. We care about the border being closed. We care about crime needing to go down. We care about our kids needing to be able to read by third grade. All these things, and Democrats have been left with making it a single-issue race because they've failed on every single other policy," she said. "The more money the Biden-Harris campaign spends on their pro-abortion campaign, the further they fall in the polls. So, it's going to be interesting. It's going to be very dynamic. But I think we can be confident that the things that we are for are the advancement of the human condition and not ending the human condition." | == Washington Examiner: Georgia Republicans Plot 2024 Comeback with Trump's Appeal to Black Voters May 17, 2024 Last month, Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler was featured in the Washington Examiner \- which highlighted Greater Georgia and its efforts to engage the black community ahead of November. The article covered Kelly's appearance at the Georgia GOP State Convention, where she joined Fox News Commentator Leo Terrell and WSB Radio Host Shelley Wynter for a fireside chat about the New Conservative Coalition. Click == to read the full article or read excerpts below: "Kelly Loeffler may not be a U.S. senator anymore, but she hasn't strayed far from the center of Georgia politics. Loeffler made an appearance at the Georgia state GOP convention in Columbus Friday to talk about how Republicans can take back the Peach State. Flanked by conservative talk radio hosts Leo Terrell and Shelley Wynter, she hosted a "fireside chat" centered largely on how to win more black voters. "Democrats need black voters more than black voters need the Democratic Party," said Loeffler, who served in the Senate in 2020 and 2021 before losing her seat to Sen. Raphael Warnock (D-GA). "The Trump coalition is good for voters of every color, every religion, every creed." | == Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler Applauds Signature of New Election Bills May 7, 2024 Last month, Governor Kemp signed a package of new election integrity bills into law - all designed to enhance election security, accuracy, and transparency. The package features several key pieces of legislation including SB 189 - which codifies some of the most significant election reforms of 2024. You can read Greater Georgia's statement about the laws above, or click == to read our full press release, including a summary of the new provisions. | | | EVENTS Georgia GOP Convention May 17, 2024 Last month, Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler joined Fox News commentator Leo Terrell at the Georgia GOP State Convention in Columbus. The two joined WSB Radio Host Shelley Wynter for a fireside chat about building lasting relationships with the black community - and how to mobilize a new, diverse coalition ahead of November. | | | | | The New Conservative Coalition Happy Hour May 16, 2024 Before heading to Columbus, Kelly and Leo made a stop in Atlanta for Greater Georgia's New Conservative Coalition Happy Hour - where guests heard from Leo, Kelly, and other community partners about the importance of the black vote. | | | | | Black Leaders Roundtable April 2024 Greater Georgia was also proud to host an intimate roundtable for local black leaders in April - where we were joined by Georgia Republican Party Chairman Josh McKoon, State Rep. Mesha Mainor, Conserve the Culture Founder Michaelah Montgomery, Frederick Douglass Foundation State Director Michael Lancaster, Georgia Black Republican Council member Darryl Wilson, and more. | | Voter Registration Drives at Clark Atlanta and Alive in Roswell April 2024 Greater Georgia also held several voter registration drives throughout the month of April. At Clark Atlanta, we set up a booth on campus during finals week, where we chatted with hundreds of students who came by on their study breaks. | Peter, **In a world where the truth often bends under political pressure, it's essential to stand firm and uphold our principles.** That's why I'm reaching out today, not just as a voice on the radio, but as a fellow patriot who believes in the resilience and integrity of our nation.

Despite the recent verdicts that feel more like a calculated political attack than justice, my support for President Trump has not faltered; it has intensified. These trials against Trump aren't just a trial of one man; **_they're a litmus test for our democracy._**

| As someone deeply embedded in the heart of conservative politics since the 2016 primaries, I've witnessed first-hand how these attempts to undermine him have unexpectedly solidified a powerful movement. **More Americans are now seeing through the façade and recognizing the manipulation of our legal systems as a direct attack on our liberties.
** Here's the truth: the efforts to undermine President Trump have inadvertently strengthened the resolve of countless Americans. We're not just defending a political figure; we're safeguarding the American Dream and the values that our country stands on. Join us as we continue to support President Trump and all he stands for. It's time to turn the tide, restore sanity to our governance, and ensure a future where justice and liberty prevail. **If you haven't already, I urge you to[ join the Common Sense Club today.](https://xtz223.keap-link006.com/v2/click/15b6de54f9ef76ebb365806d596d13db/eJyNkMsOgjAQRf9l1ghS0AU7QwghKAuja9PAKFUoTR3ER_h3CxpXmri-557JnQcQSi4pKSCAK90Z88ACjblQAiWFjSSejymb-a7nWlAJeYp10yoIHl_LH2BseR6zgG4KDbJZL8I0yeLdMslSQyquzY0_Pf7844lWi2QJff9TjLWg6GLcZwhItzgsKoRZRVtdGb4kUufAcbqus4-NkFTiXhxKYlPm23lTO1hzUU2GyNi4UiiL9ytSvL2c_RMfmGbx) Together, we will fight to end the corruption and advocate for a government that truly represents us all, one that upholds the foundational principles of our great nation.** **[Join today and you'll get access to a private members-only call I am hosting tomorrow.](https://xtz223.keap-link006.com/v2/click/030797746711c0807e52d554567a79d7/eJyNkMsOgjAQRf9l1ghY0AU7QgghqAuja9PAKFUoTR3FR_h3CxpWmri-557JnScQSi4pLSCAGz0Y88ACjblQAiVFjSSeDymb-VNvakEl5CnRzUVB8PxaHoGh5XmuBXRXaJDNOoyydJXsFukqM6Ti2tz40-PPR0-8DNMFdN1PMdaC4qtxnyEgfcF-USHMKtrqyvAlkToHjtO2rX1shKQS9-JQEnOZb-dN7WDNRTXpI2PjSqEsPq_I8P52di8d6Gbv)** Stand with us, as we not only support President Trump but also work towards a brighter, more prosperous future for every American. | Did you see this previous message from Bill? In case you missed it, check it out now: I wanted to share a touching story that recently unfolded, showcasing the incredible kindness and generosity that epitomizes the spirit of New Jersey. Last week, we received a call from Penny, a 71-year-old woman facing a challenging situation with her broken HVAC system. As she tearfully explained her predicament during a discussion about affordability in our state, something remarkable happened. Ryan, a service manager at First Choice Plumbing and Heating, listened to Penny's story and immediately offered a solution: a free HVAC system and installation. This act of kindness not only provided Penny with much-needed relief but also sparked a new friendship that warmed all our hearts.
When my wife Jodi and I visited Penny's home to witness the installation, we were deeply moved by the generosity extended by Ryan and his team. Not only did they donate the system and labor, but they also paid Penny's HOA fees for the entire year—an extraordinary gesture of compassion and solidarity. | | | Peter -

Early voting is happening NOW! Whether you vote in-person or by mail, please vote ✅ **Drew Johnson for Congress! **

I'm proud of how hard my team and I have worked to meet as many voters as possible and share my plan to reduce inflation, close the border, protect seniors, and revive the American Dream. Hopefully, we've done enough to earn your vote!

Over the past 17 months, I've:
✅ Made more than 9,000 phone calls,
✅ Spoken at more than 80 events, and
✅ Been interviewed nearly 50 times.

Our team has:
✅ Mailed more than 162,000 mailers
✅ Written almost 4,100 handwritten postcards, and
✅ Knocked an amazing 13,109 doors (as of yesterday).

**We're leading in the polls,** but we have a couple of self-funding candidates close behind us. Together, **these two big-government Republicans have spent nearly $2 million trying to beat us.** _But we won't let them!_ Please help us get across the finish line by donating $5, $50, or $250 to our campaign to help fund our last-minute mail and text message campaign.

Whether you've donated to our campaign, put a sign in your yard, written postcards, made phone calls, attended a meet & greet, or encouraged a neighbor to vote for me, I am grateful for your support. **I will repay your generosity by standing up for our principles in Congress** and working every day to be someone you can be proud to call your representative.

# **_In the Media_**
---
| Drew received an amazing endorsement from Las Vegas-based Liberty Watch magazine.

The article compares and contrasts Drew with his two closest challengers in the Republican primary for Nevada's 3rd congressional district and concludes,
---
| _Drew's "track record of working at the federal level to reduce the size and scope of government is unmatched by any candidate in Nevada. Drew Johnson isn’t just the best choice, he’s the only choice if Republicans want to win this crucial U.S. House seat in November."_
---
| Click [here](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=be0ab453e0&e=fc26432468) to read the entire article.
---
| [Drew was quoted](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=7d23d62fb7&e=fc26432468) after it was revealed one of his challengers, Marty O'Donnell, took $1.1 million in taxpayer-funded Paycheck Protection Program loans, despite having a personal fortune of more than $70 million. He never repaid the loans and has used some of the money to attempt to buy the election.
---
| _“In his TV commercials, O’Donnell stands in front of a pickup truck and talks about how hard it is to survive as a middle-class worker today in America," Drew said. "What a fraud. People like Marty are the exact reason why it’s hard for many of us to make ends meet.”_
---
| Right Side Broadcasting Network[ featured Drew's quotes](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=3dc6d1ea43&e=fc26432468) in support of Nevada's voter ID initiative.
---
| _**“Having an ID is vital for operating as a functioning adult in society," Drew said. "You need one to get a job, apply for unemployment, adopt a pet, rent a hotel room, buy cold medicine at CVS, and rent an apartment. The state government and nonprofits throughout Southern Nevada have made it easy to get an ID at no cost. There’s no good argument against a voter ID law. All it will do is restore confidence in our election system.”**_

Drew loves Goodsprings and Sandy Valley and the feeling is obviously mutual! There are "Drew Johnson for Congress" signs everywhere and we had a great turnout for our meet & greet at the [Pioneer Saloon](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=535cfea355&e=fc26432468). |

|

| Drew and Lieutenant Governor Stavros Anthony met with supporters at Turning Point Action's Freedom Rally at McKee Ranch, right in the heart of CD-3.

|

| Show your support for Drew by putting a yard sign in the front of your home!

**One of the easiest and most effective ways to support our campaign** is by putting a "Drew Johnson for Congress" sign in your yard. Almost every HOA in Southern Nevada allows at least one campaign yard sign within 30 days of the June 11 primary election. **That means you can put them up NOW!**

**We'll deliver your FREE sign right to your door!**
