name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher
subject: Happy Pride!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
June is a joyous time when we celebrate the LGBTQI+ community in Texas and across the country. It’s a time to recognize the progress we’ve made reflected in people who are living authentic, fulfilling lives. I’m proud to represent TX-07’s diverse and dynamic LGBTQI+ community—from its longtime heart in Houston’s Montrose area to every corner of the district.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240603_equalitypac?refcode=lpfe240603_equalitypac [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240603_equalitypac?refcode=lpfe240603_equalitypac]
During Pride Month, we must also recommit to our fight for the dignity and rights of all people. Our work together is especially important right now when our LGBTQI+ friends and neighbors are facing increased hostility and discrimination. State legislatures across the country have introduced more than 500 anti-LGBTQI+ bills so far this year, and we see similar efforts in the House. Those measures don’t reflect our values as Houstonians or Texans.
As a Vice Chair of the Equality Caucus, I’m proud to help lead efforts in Congress to advance equality, combat discrimination, and improve opportunities and access for our LGBTQI+ community. I’m also proud to serve on the Board of the Equality PAC. Since its founding 10 years ago, Equality PAC—the political arm of the Congressional Equality Caucus—has supported LGBTQI+ candidates and allies dedicated to the full legal and societal equality for LGBTQI+ Americans.
To bring about that change, there’s something we must do: win elections. And to win, we need campaigns, organizations, allies, and friends working together to elect the leaders we can trust.
So, this Pride Month, I’m asking you to consider making a contribution to the Equality PAC. Every dollar we raise will go toward supporting candidates who are committed to passing the Equality Act and ensuring full civil rights and protections for LGBTQI+ Americans. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240603_equalitypac?refcode=lpfe240603_equalitypac]
Each June, we are reminded of how important it is to live authentically with pride. And it’s important to elect people who will work to make that possible for all people.
Happy Pride!
Together, we can do anything,
LizzieSignature [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie_signature-1.png]

# Moving from Primaries into the Summer
---
The primary season is over. I will continue to do my job as your Senator as I move toward campaign mode. To keep my Senate duties and campaign separate, make sure you look for a new and different email from me through the summer and fall as we move to campaign season.We have been really busy working on 2025 session priorities and bills. My staff and I have been meeting endlessly with stakeholders, community members and many other people about my priorities. These areas of work will encompass Housing, Health Care, Child Care and Education as our primary focus on bills and laws to help many people, communities and businesses throughout Oregon. We are also working on a suite of ideas in the transportation realm to really put a focus on our roads in District 5 specifically. The goal of all of this will be to bring these ideas to you over the Summer. I will be rolling out a massive tour of the district in July visiting every community in the district talking about these ideas and getting feedback from you. I look forward to many discussions over the summer with hundreds and thousands of people to shape our policy and my focus in Salem for you. Government exists to serve the people, not the other way around. I look forward to visiting with many of you and get my marching orders for 2025. Sincerely,Dick

I was just appointed to the Behavioral Health Accountability Joint Task Force from HB4002 (the bill that criminalized hard drugs again in Oregon) . This is a bipartisan committee, focused on accountability of Government. There has been a lot of money going into agencies and nonprofits focused on improving mental health. It will be a watchdog on these programs to make sure the money is getting to our communities effectively to help our loved ones struggling with addiction.
**_ARTS AND CULTURE CAUCUS ANNOUNCES BIPARTISAN LEADERSHIP; SEN. DICK ANDERSON TO PARTNER WITH REP. ROB NOSSE IN ORGANIZING _** Salem, Oregon – Sen. Dick Anderson (R-Lincoln City) will join Rep. Rob Nosse (D-Portland) in organizing Oregon’s Arts and Culture Caucus, establishing bipartisan leadership of the Caucus.**“Senator Dick Anderson has been a wonderful partner in showing that arts funding truly is a bipartisan, bicameral priority,” said Rep. Nosse, who has coordinated the Caucus since its formation. “We look forward to growing our coalition together in the 2025 long session, as the Arts and Culture Caucus seeks to further advocate for arts and cultural venues of all parts of Oregon.” **The Arts and Culture Caucus launched in early 2023 in recognition of the vital role arts and culture play in the livability and prosperity of Oregon communities – and in enriching the lives of Oregonians. It serves as a resource to the Oregon Legislature on key issues impacting the arts and culture sector. Sen. Anderson was one of the inaugural members of the Caucus, which now includes 23 Legislators and is one of _Oregon’s largest bipartisan caucuses_.**“Inside the Legislature, we can find strong bipartisan bonds across the aisle with the Arts and Culture Caucus,” said Sen. Anderson. “I have witnessed the value of having a thriving arts and cultural community within the cities I represent. Recognizing this value and assisting its growth throughout all of Oregon is needed; it is an endeavor I am excited to be part of.”** Membership of the Caucus also includes Rep. Ben Bowman (D-Tigard/Metzger/South Beaverton); Rep. Janelle Bynum (D-Clackamas); Sen. Michael Dembrow (D-Portland); Rep. Maxine Dexter (D-Portland); Sen. Lew Frederick (D-North/Northeast Portland); Rep. David Gomberg (D-Otis); Rep. Dacia Grayber (D-Southwest Portland/East Beaverton); Sen. Bill Hansell (R-Athena); Rep. Annessa Hartman (D-Gladstone); Rep. Emerson Levy (D-Bend/South Redmond/Tumalo/Sisters); Rep. John Lively (D-Springfield); Sen. James Manning Jr.(D-North Eugene/West Eugene/Veneta); Rep. Kevin Mannix (R-Keizer/North Salem); Rep. Pam Marsh (D-Ashland); Sen. Mark Meek (D-Clackamas County); Rep. Daniel Nguyen (D-Lake Oswego/ Southwest Portland); Rep. Hoa Nguyen (D-East Portland/Damascus); Sen. Deb Patterson (D-Salem); Rep. Lisa Reynolds (D-Northeast Washington County); Rep. Ricki Ruiz, (D-Gresham); and Rep. Thuy Tran (D-Northeast Portland). “The interest in this Caucus, and its rapid growth, just show how much people value the arts and culture organizations in Oregon and how important it is that we support this sector,” said Rep. Nosse. “We look forward to working with the arts community and our colleagues in the Legislature on a package of bill(s) in 2025.”“Arts and culture are so important to Oregon,” added Rep. Nosse. “All around our state, every day there are concerts, comedy events, public hearings, podcasts, theatrical performances, debates and community events that bring the people of our state together. We must support the cultural and community hubs in our neighborhoods and I hope this caucus will continue to ensure arts and culture thrive in this state.” Caucus members work closely with stakeholders including the Oregon Arts Commission, the Oregon Cultural Trust (and its Statewide Partners) and the Cultural Advocacy Coalition of Oregon to stay informed on the latest research and issues. It also sets the agenda on priorities for arts and culture legislation.###

Sadly the Governor just kept going back to Gall. We signed a letter that you can read here, that was previously referenced in the article [**_here_**](https://02iut.mjt.lu/lnk/AVMAAENKEksAAAAS1cIAAIstvsUAAAAAOtEAAqwwABviTQBmXzgb_GVGlx3KQ3Sk8LytOLipvgAasDI/1/Wi3X5f6rlcDLjt7n6GNVMQ/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cub3BiLm9yZy9wZGYvMjAyNDA1MjRfUmVwdWJsaWNhblNlbmF0b3JzTGV0dGVyXzE3MTcwOTE3NjY3NDQucGRm).
| **Oregon Senate to vote on state water director pick, over GOP objections** From OPB Oregon lawmakers and water users will be keeping a close eye on the man who could soon lead the agency in charge of water rights, farm irrigation rules and oversight of drinking water wells.Oregon senators are expected to vote Friday to confirm Gov. Tina Kotek’s pick to lead the Oregon Water Resources Department, Ivan Gall, following a process that rallied ardent opposition from some GOP senators and tepid reactions from key Democrats.Those sentiments were on display Wednesday at a hearing in Salem, when senators on both sides of the political aisle scrutinized Gall’s qualifications and ability to lead the agency.“There are real concerns about the fact that you come from inside and have been perceived as being part of the problem and not part of the solution,” Sen. Elizabeth Steiner, D-Portland, said. “We’re going to be watching because we care very very deeply about ensuring that — in a state where the expression goes ‘whiskey’s for drinking and water’s for fighting’ — that we have a state system that actually minimizes the fighting.”When asked what his top three priorities are for his first 100 days at the agency, Gall said he’ll spend a significant amount of time talking to water users across the state and seeking feedback.He added that a long-term goal would be to eventually update the agency’s rules and statutes to modernize Oregon’s water law.“Nimble and adaptive water management is needed due to increase in demand, sustained drought conditions and increased water scarcity made worse by climate change,” Gall said. “Water has changed in Oregon. What has worked in the past is no longer working for us. We will need collaboration, common sense and compromise for us to succeed.”Earlier this month, Kotek announced Gall as her choice to lead the Oregon Water Resources Department, or OWRD, after she previously passed over the longtime agency insider’s application during a nearly yearlong candidate search.Gall’s nomination has stoked political pushback from some Republican senators while also unifying support from water conservation groups. Both sides do share a common ground — all say the director’s job is critical at a time when leaders look to change how the state manages water so that there’s enough to go around in the future.It’s unlikely the minority Republican Party’s opposition to Gall will sway the final Senate vote. That opposition does mean the state’s next water resources director is poised to begin his tenure on a political tightrope, though, while his agency is in the middle of drafting the most significant groundwater policy changes Oregon has seen in decades.On May 24, 10 GOP senators put pressure on Kotek to outright withdraw the nomination in a letter stating they have “significant reservations” about Gall, who is currently OWRD’s interim deputy director. The senators are openly opposed to Gall’s nomination, while some Democratic senators either did not respond to requests for comment, or declined to speak on the record.“Mr. Gall is an inexperienced leader that will likely perpetuate the status quo of a paralyzed inefficient agency that routinely misses its own performance measures and fails to meet its core mission of co-equally managing water for out-of-stream and in-stream uses,” reads the Republican senators’ letter.Gall, who declined to be interviewed in advance of his confirmation, has worked at the state water agency for more than 25 years. His nomination comes as OWRD is in the midst of drafting major changes to the state’s groundwater policy, getting support from environmental groups, and opposition from some agricultural interests and Central Oregon city leaders.The Republicans’ letter to Kotek criticizes Gall’s support for those proposed groundwater changes, which would lead to statewide restrictions on new wells in areas where aquifers are dropping. The senators wrote Gall “seems unwilling to explore alternative approaches.”But in an interview, Sen. Lynn Findley, R-Vale, said his opposition to Gall isn’t tied to specific policies, but rather the department’s overall track record.“Could he hit the ground running? Absolutely. But, the problem is the agency desperately needs to redirect itself and fix itself and I don’t think he’s the guy to do that,” Findley said.The governor’s office did not respond to requests for comment on the senators’ objections.

In this short legislative session, HB4132 (the Marine Reserves Bill), was introduced by coastal legislators and seeks to reinvest Oregon in our oceans and marine reserves. The bill gives the Oregon Department of Fish and Wildlife, the stewards of the Program, nearly $1 million for the biennium to improve it. I was proud to be at this bill signing with my coastal caucus colleagues!

I was able to go to another bill signing for the Oregon REALTORS bill we helped get across both chambers this year. This bill will help transparency in real estate transactions for both buyers and sellers. We are also helping seniors and others with some requirements for anyone wanting to lock in long term contracts. This bill had broad bipartisan support.

Nosse, who has coordinated the Caucus since its formation. “We look forward to growing our coalition together in the 2025 long session, as the Arts and Culture Caucus seeks to further advocate for arts and cultural venues of all parts of Oregon.” The Arts and Culture Caucus launched in early 2023 in recognition of the vital role arts and culture play in the livability and prosperity of Oregon communities – and in enriching the lives of Oregonians. It serves as a resource to the Oregon Legislature on key issues impacting the arts and culture sector. Sen. Anderson was one of the inaugural members of the Caucus, which now includes 23 Legislators and is one of Oregon’s largest bipartisan caucuses.“Inside the Legislature, we can find strong bipartisan bonds across the aisle with the Arts and Culture Caucus,” said Sen. Anderson. “I have witnessed the value of having a thriving arts and cultural community within the cities I represent. Recognizing this value and assisting its growth throughout all of Oregon is needed; it is an endeavor I am excited to be part of.” Membership of the Caucus also includes Rep. Ben Bowman (D-Tigard/Metzger/South Beaverton); Rep. Janelle Bynum (D-Clackamas); Sen. Michael Dembrow (D-Portland); Rep. Maxine Dexter (D-Portland); Sen. Lew Frederick (D-North/Northeast Portland); Rep. David Gomberg (D-Otis); Rep. Dacia Grayber (D-Southwest Portland/East Beaverton); Sen. Bill Hansell (R-Athena); Rep. Annessa Hartman (D-Gladstone); Rep. Emerson Levy (D-Bend/South Redmond/Tumalo/Sisters); Rep. John Lively (D-Springfield); Sen. James Manning Jr.(D-North Eugene/West Eugene/Veneta); Rep. Kevin Mannix (R-Keizer/North Salem); Rep. Pam Marsh (D-Ashland); Sen. Mark Meek (D-Clackamas County); Rep. Daniel Nguyen (D-Lake Oswego/ Southwest Portland); Rep. Hoa Nguyen (D-East Portland/Damascus); Sen. Deb Patterson (D-Salem); Rep. Lisa Reynolds (D-Northeast Washington County); Rep. Ricki Ruiz, (D-Gresham); and Rep. Thuy Tran (D-Northeast Portland). “The interest in this Caucus, and its rapid growth, just show how much people value the arts and culture organizations in Oregon and how important it is that we support this sector,” said Rep. Nosse. “We look forward to working with the arts community and our colleagues in the Legislature on a package of bill(s) in 2025.”“Arts and culture are so important to Oregon,” added Rep. Nosse. “All around our state, every day there are concerts, comedy events, public hearings, podcasts, theatrical performances, debates and community events that bring the people of our state together. We must support the cultural and community hubs in our neighborhoods and I hope this caucus will continue to ensure arts and culture thrive in this state.” Caucus members work closely with stakeholders including the Oregon Arts Commission, the Oregon Cultural Trust (and its Statewide Partners) and the Cultural Advocacy Coalition of Oregon to stay informed on the latest research and issues. It also sets the agenda on priorities for arts and culture legislation.### I put the full article from OPB on the OWRD (Oregon Water Resources Department) director appointment from this past week. My fellow Republicans and I objected again to the appointment of Ivan Gall to lead the department. Water Resources is a failing agency in need of a complete reset, not more of the same. Sadly the Governor just kept going back to Gall. We signed a letter that you can read here, that was previously referenced in the article . | Oregon Senate to vote on state water director pick, over GOP objections From OPB Oregon lawmakers and water users will be keeping a close eye on the man who could soon lead the agency in charge of water rights, farm irrigation rules and oversight of drinking water wells.Oregon senators are expected to vote Friday to confirm Gov. Tina Kotek’s pick to lead the Oregon Water Resources Department, Ivan Gall, following a process that rallied ardent opposition from some GOP senators and tepid reactions from key Democrats.Those sentiments were on display Wednesday at a hearing in Salem, when senators on both sides of the political aisle scrutinized Gall’s qualifications and ability to lead the agency.“There are real concerns about the fact that you come from inside and have been perceived as being part of the problem and not part of the solution,” Sen. Elizabeth Steiner, D-Portland, said. “We’re going to be watching because we care very very deeply about ensuring that — in a state where the expression goes ‘whiskey’s for drinking and water’s for fighting’ — that we have a state system that actually minimizes the fighting.”When asked what his top three priorities are for his first 100 days at the agency, Gall said he’ll spend a significant amount of time talking to water users across the state and seeking feedback.He added that a long-term goal would be to eventually update the agency’s rules and statutes to modernize Oregon’s water law.“Nimble and adaptive water management is needed due to increase in demand, sustained drought conditions and increased water scarcity made worse by climate change,” Gall said. “Water has changed in Oregon. What has worked in the past is no longer working for us. We will need collaboration, common sense and compromise for us to succeed.”Earlier this month, Kotek announced Gall as her choice to lead the Oregon Water Resources Department, or OWRD, after she previously passed over the longtime agency insider’s application during a nearly yearlong candidate search.Gall’s nomination has stoked political pushback from some Republican senators while also unifying support from water conservation groups. Both sides do share a common ground — all say the director’s job is critical at a time when leaders look to change how the state manages water so that there’s enough to go around in the future.It’s unlikely the minority Republican Party’s opposition to Gall will sway the final Senate vote. That opposition does mean the state’s next water resources director is poised to begin his tenure on a political tightrope, though, while his agency is in the middle of drafting the most significant groundwater policy changes Oregon has seen in decades.On May 24, 10 GOP senators put pressure on Kotek to outright withdraw the nomination in a letter stating they have “significant reservations” about Gall, who is currently OWRD’s interim deputy director. The senators are openly opposed to Gall’s nomination, while some Democratic senators either did not respond to requests for comment, or declined to speak on the record.“Mr. Gall is an inexperienced leader that will likely perpetuate the status quo of a paralyzed inefficient agency that routinely misses its own performance measures and fails to meet its core mission of co-equally managing water for out-of-stream and in-stream uses,” reads the Republican senators’ letter.Gall, who declined to be interviewed in advance of his confirmation, has worked at the state water agency for more than 25 years. His nomination comes as OWRD is in the midst of drafting major changes to the state’s groundwater policy, getting support from environmental groups, and opposition from some agricultural interests and Central Oregon city leaders.The Republicans’ letter to Kotek criticizes Gall’s support for those proposed groundwater changes, which would lead to statewide restrictions on new wells in areas where aquifers are dropping. The senators wrote Gall “seems unwilling to explore alternative approaches.”But in an interview, Sen. Lynn Findley, R-Vale, said his opposition to Gall isn’t tied to specific policies, but rather the department’s overall track record.“Could he hit the ground running? Absolutely. But, the problem is the agency desperately needs to redirect itself and fix itself and I don’t think he’s the guy to do that,” Findley said.The governor’s office did not respond to requests for comment on the senators’ objections. | In this short legislative session, HB4132 (the Marine Reserves Bill), was introduced by coastal legislators and seeks to reinvest Oregon in our oceans and marine reserves. The bill gives the Oregon Department of Fish and Wildlife, the stewards of the Program, nearly $1 million for the biennium to improve it. I was proud to be at this bill signing with my coastal caucus colleagues! | I was able to go to another bill signing for the Oregon REALTORS bill we helped get across both chambers this year. This bill will help transparency in real estate transactions for both buyers and sellers. We are also helping seniors and others with some requirements for anyone wanting to lock in long term contracts. This bill had broad bipartisan support. | On May 30th I co-chaired the B'nai B'rith Camp Spaghetti Dinner with my wife, Sue. We hold this event annually to raise scholarship funds for local kids to attend day camp. We had a great turnout and great spaghetti. | | I'm in Salem for You. **There have been so many trailblazers and pioneers before me, it made me wonder: is there anything left for me to do?**
That thought came to a screeching halt in the summer of 2020 when demonstrations demanding justice for George Floyd took off, first in Minneapolis, and then across the entire country. Seeing the nonviolent power wielded by concerned communities against sometimes brutal riot police and law enforcement had a profound effect on me.
When school got cancelled during the pandemic, I went back to my hometown in New Haven County, CT to get together with friends and peers and see what we could do about the ongoing political tension.
In the course of creating a racial equality project together, I got hands-on experience that taught me**invaluable skills in fundraising, community organizing, and navigating differing perspectives.** When I returned to campus and declared pre-law and politics majors, my coursework cultivated and expanded these interests even more. Moving forward, I sought out every opportunity to complete political research, work on electoral campaigns, and intern for issue-driven nonprofit organizations – one of these internships being with Movement Labs!
**Now, I'm here as a full-time employee, helping to grow, build, and sustain a movement making change from the ground floor on up.**
[Donate Now](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86250889/477306240/-327605227?refcode=2024-06-04-solace-fwd&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=f517b97e-8b22-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTVAvMS85MjA2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNTE3Yjk3ZS04YjIyLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UxvehXgBdr1toLQuhGLoK2pKmo3Pv3BCPOUGo3WYGFU=)
It takes grace, empathy, and fervor to press forward with a progressive agenda, but that's exactly what my colleagues and I are doing and why I'm so proud to be part of this movement.
[**If you feel the same, I encourage you to get involved, read up, talk to friends, and chip in when we pass around the hat.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86250893/477306243/-327605227?refcode=2024-06-04-solace-fwd&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=f517b97e-8b22-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTVAvMS85MjA2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNTE3Yjk3ZS04YjIyLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UxvehXgBdr1toLQuhGLoK2pKmo3Pv3BCPOUGo3WYGFU=)
It's time to dismantle the barriers holding us back and keeping us down. That's what the progressive movement is all about!
In solidarity,
_Solace_

That’s why I’m fighting tooth and nail, day in and day out, to keep politicians out of our doctors’ offices. Republicans are systematically enacting abortion bans across the country. Most recently, we’ve seen it in Florida and Arizona. And if we think for one second that they’ll hesitate to enact a national ban the second they have the Senate majority? Well, we’re in for a rude and devastating awakening. = Your help is so needed, and I’m grateful that you’re getting involved. Peter,

With the conviction of Donald Trump on 34 felony counts, it is clear that no one is above the law. This is a reminder of the critical importance of integrity and accountability in our leaders.

Unfortunately, our current Senator Roger Wicker was quick to embrace, endorse, and enable Donald Trump despite overwhelming evidence of his wrongdoing.

This is a betrayal of the trust that voters place in their elected officials. By aligning himself with a convicted felon, Senator Wicker has shown a blatant disregard for the values of justice and integrity that we hold dear.

As a veteran who has dedicated my life to serving our country, I believe in the rule of law and the fundamental principles that underpin our democracy. We need leaders who will stand up for what is right, not those who will turn a blind eye to corruption and criminal behavior.

It is time for a new chapter in our leadership — one that prioritizes the well-being of our communities over partisan loyalty. As your U.S. Senator, I will always fight for justice, accountability, and the best interests of people over party.

We deserve better than leaders who will compromise their principles for political gain. We need leaders who will uphold the highest standards of ethics and honor. Afterwards, our hosts turn to the recent **Republican primary in Texas' 23rd Congressional District** , where incumbent Rep. Tony Gonzales edged out YouTuber and gun advocate Brandon "AK Guy" Herrera, despite the latter's endorsement from Donald Trump.

subject: Sign this beautiful letter of love and support to stand with Trump!

body:
We're sending President Trump a beautiful letter to make sure he feels our love and support. Will you co-sign it?

|
---
| | |
Friend,

God bless President Trump!

_**During this dark time for our great nation, we must surround President Trump with the LOVE and JOY of our MAGA movement. **_

name: David Horowitz
subject: the enemy within
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ACaudbvFHJYmZqEryElh2Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRoQd20P0SraHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9kYXZpZC1ob3Jvd2l0ei1mcmVlZG9tLWNlbnRlci83MWNhM2E0YS02OGQxLTQyNTMtYTM4MC1kMTU5YWE0Mzc3MTQ_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwNjA0X0JER19ESEZDX09CRTJfUkVOX1BBLUNCVwNzcGNCCmZV70dfZiBReg1SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ACaudbvFHJYmZqEryElh2Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRoQd20P0SraHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9kYXZpZC1ob3Jvd2l0ei1mcmVlZG9tLWNlbnRlci83MWNhM2E0YS02OGQxLTQyNTMtYTM4MC1kMTU5YWE0Mzc3MTQ_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwNjA0X0JER19ESEZDX09CRTJfUkVOX1BBLUNCVwNzcGNCCmZV70dfZiBReg1SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.

David Horowitz

**I’m running for Congress in Virginia to fight back against Trump and the far-right Republicans who enable his abuse of power and attacks on our Democracy.**
And more than that, I’m running to push our country forward across the board. To restore abortion rights everywhere, act on climate change, and lower costs for working families.

body:
Love is love!
#
Happy Pride Month, Derek!
[](https://act.johnfetterman.com/signup/jf-email-pride-month-2024/?source=em20240604-9074&akid=9074%2E434096%2EoprWsI)
**Pride is a time to celebrate the immense progress we have made to secure the rights of people to love as comes naturally to them.** While we take a moment to applaud the sacrifices that it took to get here and celebrate how far we’ve come, we also must keep our eyes on institutions that want to see those rights walked back.
Last year, I was quick to condemn the Supreme Court decision on _303 Creative LLC v. Elenis_ , where the Court ruled in favor of an evangelical Christian web designer from Colorado who refused to work on same-sex weddings. This ruling was despicable — a full-on assault on LGBTQ+ people in America.
As Republicans continue their quest to eviscerate LGBTQ+ rights, nearly half of LGBTQ+ Americans report feeling unsafe in their own country. The Human Rights Campaign has declared a “state of emergency” for the LGBTQ+ community in America and the United Nations has expressed concern “at the increase in the number of state laws that severely restrict the rights of persons on the basis of their sexual orientation or gender identity.”
**We have got to fight back** – that’s my motive in the Senate. Here’s what’s on my to-do list to defend and advance LGBTQ+ rights in the Senate:
* **Vote to finally pass the Equality Act** , which would ensure that civil rights laws — like protections against discrimination in employment and housing — apply to sexual orientation and gender identity.
* **Support efforts to end the hateful practice of so-called “conversion therapy”**
* **Fight to strengthen anti-harassment policies on school and college campuses.**

So today I’m not just asking for donations for my campaign. I’m asking you to help me see the critical goals on our to-do list through to the finish line. **[Sign my petition to show your support for LGBTQ+ rights this Pride Month.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/signup/jf-email-pride-month-2024/?source=em20240604-9074&akid=9074%2E434096%2EoprWsI)**
**[Sign the Petition »](https://act.johnfetterman.com/signup/jf-email-pride-month-2024/?source=em20240604-9074&akid=9074%2E434096%2EoprWsI)**
With your support, we can get these three important things done — and more!
❤️ John
John Fetterman
U.S. Senator for Pennsylvania

name: Jill Stein
subject: Did you read this email about Illinois?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
We have another huge ballot fight on our hands.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=il_resend&n=1)
---
Peter, I sent this email a few days back, and wanted to make sure you got a chance to read it. The two-party system has made it extremely difficult for people-powered campaigns like ours to get on the ballot, and some states make it much harder than others. Right now, we’re turning our focus to the next big challenge: [Illinois](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ilballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=il_resend&n=2). We have to submit 25,000 valid signatures by the June 24th deadline - meaning we need closer to 50,000 signatures to be able to withstand a likely challenge from the Democratic Party. Democrats across the country are hiring political operatives and lawyers to keep grassroots campaigns like ours off the ballot. **We can’t let them succeed.** We’re going all out to make sure over 8 million Illinois voters have a pro-worker, anti-war, anti-genocide, climate action choice on the ballot - and to make it happen **we need your help now.** **Our most critical need right now is for people to collect signatures in Illinois.** If you can petition in Illinois, we need your help! There are more ways to help too - like providing homestays for volunteers petitioning in Illinois. **However you can help, please let us know now:**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ilballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=il_resend&n=3 "HELP JILL GET ON THE IL BALLOT") [HELP JILL GET ON THE IL BALLOT](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ilballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=il_resend&n=3)
---
**We also need everyone to donate whatever they can to help fund this urgent ballot drive.** To undertake this massive and critically important petition drive, we need to raise $300,000 this month. Every dollar you can donate moves us closer to the crucial goal of getting 25,000 valid signatures in Illinois. **Please pitch in as much as you can now to help make it happen!**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/illinois?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=il_resend&n=4 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/illinois?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=il_resend&n=4)
---
You’ve likely heard by now about the **astounding volunteer mobilization in New York that brought in 10 times as many signatures as all other grassroots campaigns!** Though we fell just short of New York’s outrageous ballot access signature requirement, **we’re not done fighting**. We are pursuing strong legal options to challenge New York’s unjust, anti-democratic laws and get on the ballot. So **we are still very much on track to be the only anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate action campaign on the ballot across the country.** **But that all depends on what happens in the next three weeks in Illinois.** Like New York, Illinois is another Democratic Party-dominated state that makes it extremely difficult for Greens and other independents to get on the ballot. To get the signatures we need by the fast-approaching deadline, we need everyone who supports this campaign to do what they can to help _now._ Our campaign has been building momentum fast. Media attention has exploded, poll numbers are rising, more and more supporters are joining every day - and we are slowly but surely getting on the ballot across the country, with success stories in Alaska, Georgia, Idaho, Nevada and more. **But it’s absolutely critical that we harness that momentum to overcome the biggest ballot access challenges - and right now, that means Illinois.** **If you believe in this movement for people, planet, and peace that we have struggled so hard for so many years to build, I ask you to rise to seize this historic opportunity for political change and do whatever you can to help us get on the ballot in Illinois.**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ilballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=il_resend&n=5 "HELP JILL GET ON THE IL BALLOT") [HELP JILL GET ON THE IL BALLOT](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ilballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=il_resend&n=5)
---
Please share this urgent message with your friends, family, and fellow activists. We can do this if we all work together - but we need _everyone_ to answer the call. Thank you for everything you do to fight for an America and a world that works for all of us! **Gratitude and solidarity!** Jill Stein
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/illinois?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=il_resend&n=6 "DONATE") [DONATE](https://www.jillstein2024.com/illinois?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=il_resend&n=6)

At the Jane Fonda Climate PAC, we’re fighting like hell to elect leaders who have made it their mission to take on these Big Oil giants. One of our endorsed climate champions is **Chicago Mayor Brandon Johnson.** His administration is making headlines by suing major oil and gas companies for intentionally misleading the public about the harms of their products and demanding reparations for climate-related damages.
Mayor Johnson’s lawsuit is part of a broader movement where cities and states around the country are stepping up to hold fossil fuel giants accountable in court. This is just the beginning. The industry has evaded responsibility for too long, but the tide is turning.
**We want to know if you’re with us. Do you agree with the majority of U.S. voters who support climate litigation against Big Oil?**

God bless you!

During this dark time for America, we wanted to send you this letter to make sure you feel our love and support.

So let us start by saying, from the bottom of our hearts, THANK YOU!

Thank you for protecting us from the Radical Left hordes that want to destroy our country and our movement.

Thank you for never surrendering to these evil forces that want to destroy America.

And thank you for sacrificing yourself for us.

We know that they are after all of us, but you are selflessly standing in their way.

Thats why:

WE WILL NEVER STOP FIGHTING FOR YOU.

WE WILL NEVER STOP PRAYING FOR YOU.

AND WE WILL NEVER ABANDON YOU.

The Radical Left may have won this battle, but we will win the war.

Because the real verdict will come on November 5th!

During this dark time in America, I hope you feel the love of the millions of patriotic Americans who have your back.

And I hope you know that our movement is more committed than ever to doing everything we can to defeat Joe Biden in November.

Justice will be served. We will make sure of it.

God bless you President Trump, and God help America.

Sincerely,

{YOUR SIGNATURE}

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: “Nowhere to go but the voting booth.”
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY POWERED BY PEOPLE, POWEREDXPEOPLE
body:
Lost for many in the wake of Donald Trump’s conviction on 34 separate
felony counts was the Texas Supreme Court’s ruling against Texas women
last week.

Twenty women, all of whom had serious pregnancy complications, sued over
the state’s extreme abortion law in an effort to gain clarity for doctors
and patients about when an abortion can legally be performed. The
unanimous ruling against them – essentially declaring that the vague
language in the current law must be interpreted by doctors at their own
risk – confirms that there are no exceptions for pregnant women in Texas.
Not for rape, not for incest, not even for the life of the mother.

The stories that drove the lawsuit make it clear that Texas leaders are
hurting Texas women. The lead plaintiff, Amanda Zurawski, had been told
that her baby would not survive. She was then forced to wait until she
developed a life-threatening case of sepsis before being provided an
abortion. After three days in the hospital, she was left with a
permanently closed fallopian tube and may not be able to have more
children.

She responded to the Texas Supreme Court’s ruling, saying, “I am outraged
on behalf of my fellow plaintiffs who the Court deemed not sick enough. We
all deserve bodily autonomy. Every day, people in Texas are being told
that they have no options. It’s sickening and wrong.”

Center for Reproductive Rights attorney Molly Duane represented Zurawksi
and the other plaintiffs and told reporters afterwards that, at this
point, “Texans have nowhere to go but the voting booth.”

That’s where all of us can do our part. At Powered by People, we register
pro-choice Texans to vote and then we stay in touch with these new voters
personally and individually – not through mass-emails or broadcast-text
messages – to connect the issues they care most about with the candidates
who will fight for them.

Meanwhile, Trump raked in over $50 million after becoming a convicted criminal. NOW, IN JUNE: We’re fighting to make up lost ground. | | Every election should be fair, Peter. But the 2024 election might not be as fair as the media and establishment would have you believe. The sad truth is that since the U.S. census stopped asking who is a citizen, _**[**illegal immigrants have awarded Democrat-run sanctuary states extra House seats, and as a result, votes in the Electoral College.**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9cf94c0c7b8540078def7023fcccc44a&_e=7x1S0zFF6FX5QcIfEGENopAiNX7WrLWuf9Z3pvDJSgY7S4vKr30nSs_HgND6SKXLn5V6guEY06-IJNLt9KghOrxG0L17Z4LQmHc0Aoldd-ARETstnEiFzxwyMsKJZ8ATkyVlvJODgs7wBPxL4ClQAvO61jPdoS6nFy5TAVI-zjdUfdA3SD3bvvysZlxz-RRjHgumKmGsItiS_vrx0CvDSMTOvrdqa7cT6e5KnAdzTZtg9gtQKsl8i26TJsY0ZdWBNC_CHPTkknBjDzVp3SF1ngIOh5ufcWnEvLVEZnXbueBc8nOAKtUpJK4OtrfzlfIcpWXgmYbuPpVUSWFBbV7r7znoBKAQhbbLHhyw9kcpuA9clVzXmLhfNbCA0SDaNOCoVIJVnrxoMtkodDN-YQX3Kw%3D%3D)**_ If the 2024 election is as close as the polls say, these extra seats and votes could tip the election. **That’s why Heritage Action is pushing for Congress to fix elections by pressuring the Senate to pass the Equal Representation Act, just as the House did.** This will bring back the citizenship question on the U.S. census and stop illegal immigrants from awarding Democrat-run sanctuary states more congressional seats and extra Electoral College votes. Here at Heritage Action, we want to make it **easier to vote** and **harder to cheat** , but we know that the far-left wants to do everything they can to stop us. They will fight tooth and nail to stop this bill, so we’re reaching out to our strongest supporters to help us get it passed. _**[**Please chip in anything you can before the vote so we can pressure Congress to fix our elections. >>**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9cf94c0c7b8540078def7023fcccc44a&_e=7x1S0zFF6FX5QcIfEGENopAiNX7WrLWuf9Z3pvDJSgY7S4vKr30nSs_HgND6SKXLn5V6guEY06-IJNLt9KghOrxG0L17Z4LQmHc0Aoldd-ARETstnEiFzxwyMsKJZ8ATkyVlvJODgs7wBPxL4ClQAvO61jPdoS6nFy5TAVI-zjdUfdA3SD3bvvysZlxz-RRjHgumKmGsItiS_vrx0CvDSMTOvrdqa7cT6e5KnAdzTZs_P1wotmIjsakP8Na2g2fRN6xfqjE2jGumaQYy4Qtzd90tmnLMEDVGH5CfYyRWE5ZqKoXjEDWbhSgIcUVrRyatQqsMqVjc41PS2DK1RdMpNGxeD0rCje7k1_DRwX7w9S6kgApESuTbb8OrgCr0ae-BmUoaB84l1dyd0pwqLCum8g%3D%3D)**_

Here at Heritage Action, we want to make it easier to vote and harder to cheat , but we know that the far-left wants to do everything they can to stop us. They will fight tooth and nail to stop this bill, so we’re reaching out to our strongest supporters to help us get it passed. I’m confident this could be the single most important piece of legislation we pass before November, and I couldn’t be more grateful for your support. Thank you for your commitment to fighting for fair elections, Peter. The freedom to love and the fight ahead: Happy Pride Month, Peter!

**This month, we honor the LGBTQ+ community, celebrating their strength, resilience, and the vibrant diversity they bring to our communities and our world.** But, as we celebrate, it's important to remember the ongoing challenges LGBTQ+ folks face, especially right here in Missouri.

Across the country, we've seen a rise in anti-LGBTQ+ laws that threaten the rights and safety of our friends, neighbors, and family members. The ACLU is tracking 39 different bills in our state legislature alone that are attempting to take away the rights of LGBTQ+ folks.

These laws are not just words on paper; they represent a dangerous step backward, putting the safety and dignity of LGBTQ+ individuals at risk every single day.

From restrictions on gender-affirming care to bans on discussing sexual orientation and gender in schools, these measures aim to erase the identities and experiences of many Missourians, including those in St. Louis.

**While we've made progress in protecting the rights of all Americans, our work is far from over. Discrimination and prejudice still exist, and we must continue to fight for equality and justice for ALL Americans.**

I hope you'll join me in supporting the LGBTQ+ community and their allies – not just in June, _**but every single day.**_ Together, we can create a society where everyone is treated with dignity, respect, and equality, _no matter who they love or how they identify._

Wishing you a happy and safe Pride Month!

In solidarity,

clean_body: The freedom to love and the fight ahead: Happy Pride Month, Peter! This month, we honor the LGBTQ+ community, celebrating their strength, resilience, and the vibrant diversity they bring to our communities and our world. But, as we celebrate, it's important to remember the ongoing challenges LGBTQ+ folks face, especially right here in Missouri. Across the country, we've seen a rise in anti-LGBTQ+ laws that threaten the rights and safety of our friends, neighbors, and family members. The ACLU is tracking 39 different bills in our state legislature alone that are attempting to take away the rights of LGBTQ+ folks. These laws are not just words on paper; they represent a dangerous step backward, putting the safety and dignity of LGBTQ+ individuals at risk every single day. From restrictions on gender-affirming care to bans on discussing sexual orientation and gender in schools, these measures aim to erase the identities and experiences of many Missourians, including those in St. Louis. While we've made progress in protecting the rights of all Americans, our work is far from over. Discrimination and prejudice still exist, and we must continue to fight for equality and justice for ALL Americans. I hope you'll join me in supporting the LGBTQ+ community and their allies – not just in June, but every single day. Together, we can create a society where everyone is treated with dignity, respect, and equality, no matter who they love or how they identify. Wishing you a happy and safe Pride Month! # Why Frederick Douglass?
---
| **A Force for Uniting the United States:** Frederick Douglass serves as a powerful symbol for Republicans to promote the values and principles that make our nation unique. He was born into slavery in 1818, but later became one of the leading advocates for reuniting our nation as the Civil War came to an end. His strong conviction in the power of our founding values and constitutional principles, along with his self-learned eloquence, helped guide Abraham Lincoln and the recently formed Republican party to win a second term based on these values and principles. Lincoln faced the daunting challenge of rescuing a nation divided by the Civil War.
**Believed in American Principles:** History tells us that Lincoln's wholehearted embrace of Douglass's message of fighting for and preserving the values that formed our nation was not only the winning message, but also the roadmap for reunification. Today, as our nation becomes increasingly fragmented along political issues and divergent views of our fundamental values and principles of freedom, engaging people based on this former slave's unassailable historical contribution offers the most effective messaging for winning new hearts and minds.
**A Symbol of Republican Values:** Just as Lincoln turned to Douglass for guiding the salvation of America, Republicans can leverage Douglass as a pivotal symbol for fully realizing the greatness of our country. In a historical context, emulating Lincoln and using the impactful legacy of Frederick Douglass serves to open the door to all voters to find common ground and reunite our country.
**Frederick Douglass played a crucial role in the birth of the Republican Party:** The Republican Party was founded in 1854 by abolitionists who aimed to end slavery and advocate for the civil rights of Black people, with Frederick Douglass playing a significant role in initiating the political campaign.

Dear President Trump,

God bless you!

During this dark time for America, we wanted to send you this letter to make sure you feel our love and support.

So let us start by saying, from the bottom of our hearts, THANK YOU!

Thank you for protecting us from the Radical Left hordes that want to destroy our country and our movement.

Thank you for never surrendering to these evil forces that want to destroy America.

And thank you for sacrificing yourself for us.

We know that they are after all of us, but you are selflessly standing in their way.

Thats why:

WE WILL NEVER STOP FIGHTING FOR YOU.

WE WILL NEVER STOP PRAYING FOR YOU.

AND WE WILL NEVER ABANDON YOU.

The Radical Left may have won this battle, but we will win the war.

Because the real verdict will come on November 5th!

During this dark time in America, I hope you feel the love of the millions of patriotic Americans who have your back.

And I hope you know that our movement is more committed than ever to doing everything we can to defeat Joe Biden in November.

Justice will be served. We will make sure of it.

God bless you President Trump, and God help America.

Sincerely,

{YOUR SIGNATURE}

| Peter, Happy Pride Month! **🌈**

As we come together to celebrate love, diversity, and the strides we've made toward equality, we must also recognize the urgent challenges that still face the LGBTQ+ community.

Over the last couple of years, we’ve seen extremists in legislatures across the country introduce an alarming amount of anti-LGBTQ+ legislation and book bans aimed at silencing and discriminating against the LGBTQ+ community.

**The fight for equality is far from over. I know we must do more to ensure that everyone feels included, whether that be in the halls of Congress or in classrooms across the country.**

That’s why I am a proud cosponsor of the Equality Act, and I promise to continue to be a champion for the rights and dignity of all individuals, regardless of who they love or how they identify.

This Pride Month, let’s honor the progress we’ve made by doubling down on our efforts to protect and expand the rights of the LGBTQ+ community.

Together, we can push back against hate and ensure that every person can live openly and proudly.

Susan

clean_body: As we come together to celebrate love, diversity, and the strides we've made toward equality, we must also recognize the urgent challenges that still face the LGBTQ+ community. | = | Peter, Happy Pride Month! 🌈 As we come together to celebrate love, diversity, and the strides we've made toward equality, we must also recognize the urgent challenges that still face the LGBTQ+ community. Over the last couple of years, we’ve seen extremists in legislatures across the country introduce an alarming amount of anti-LGBTQ+ legislation and book bans aimed at silencing and discriminating against the LGBTQ+ community. The fight for equality is far from over. I know we must do more to ensure that everyone feels included, whether that be in the halls of Congress or in classrooms across the country. That’s why I am a proud cosponsor of the Equality Act, and I promise to continue to be a champion for the rights and dignity of all individuals, regardless of who they love or how they identify. This Pride Month, let’s honor the progress we’ve made by doubling down on our efforts to protect and expand the rights of the LGBTQ+ community. Together, we can push back against hate and ensure that every person can live openly and proudly. | | Dear Fellow American, American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point. In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in your local schools. As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats? Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation's history? We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America's future. For this reason, we have produced the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ --and I'm writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide. **What is the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_? ** The**_Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_** is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively. This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College--and we are making it available **free of charge**. To be clear, the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ is not a _slap-dash_ response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children. It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844. And we need your help to make the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available **free of charge** so that it will have the greatest impact. _We have set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ and our other outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative_. That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: **Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you--citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission--to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty." With that mission in mind, we produced the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ --and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to _**support the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_ and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty**_**?** Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty--and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty--I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. **I 've included a secure link for your convenience here: ** _**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-hillsdale-1776-curriculum](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=8dac6bd4bd2a47de87eaa17251c12c83&_e=cz4a4u1UFUilRitL_J5sqiQPEHKhVlVzDjBmvigURXuUEsWX220jth9TKFqUGIH9Gc7fM451uLxhYZXb6fXnUYmqXJSihFXvn5mamnMTNsS22rSfsheGHGBpX9caSNlMTxURzbFw_ujuJ66YnpU5DvaqXe_rsizcKHnuj_mmiEWCWtBXoecY9BEIhds2ENdB-OpMEfKz8uRFI2C4Ee9kGfVczXT28oyzYxe9jJiyanzCzgofh8v2EiSKV7GZrkucCLUXgAJ5f0s9Z9c19h5FNgW5xApsmj3YkJHC7VjT7Mh7fh-HGzPm-sA7WHfKf6JygMj5Ia9hFx7nqabyGlGjjg_T0PoDO0i2aDFVJ7wtiLMd9r711Me8-rCMkka-_8rv9OF3BFre5iJF_a88CBY9I9YzxgPD5Bk6EnDFZJhLgkQ%3D)**_ Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you--citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission--to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty." With that mission in mind, we produced the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum --and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to support the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty? Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty--and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty--I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. I 've included a secure link for your convenience here: Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 .

As Cori’s campaign manager, it’s my job to stay up-to-date on the status of this race.

Last week, Donald Trump was convicted on 34 felony charges. However, you and I both know that a guilty verdict won’t impact his Republican nomination for President. In fact, his megadonors will flock to him. And she is advocating for our reproductive freedoms and to make sure that NO politician has ANY place in our reproductive decisions. That’s what Congresswoman Cori Bush is working for every day in the Halls of Power.

" In Colorado's redrawn 4th Congressional District, State Rep. Mike Lynch, a small business owner in Loveland, has the clearest path to victory over Boebert.
Lynch is a graduate of the U.S. Military Academy at West Point and his campaign is off to a bit of a slow start because he was busy working to pass bipartisan laws as a state Representative.
He is best suited to defeat Ike McCorkle, also a veteran, in the General Election in November. Recent internal polls (less reliable than public polls) have shown that while many voters in CD4 are undecided, more say they would support McCorkle than Boebert in November."

Happy Pride, Peter! 54 years since the first Pride march was held, we recognize and celebrate that love is love. Everyone deserves to live their life truly and authentically to who they are.

Unfortunately, this right is still under attack today. Across the country, radical Republicans have actively used their power to silence the voices of the LGBTQ+ community. From influencing school policies that limit protections for LGBTQ+ identifying individuals to restricting access to gender-affirming care, radical Republicans are clear about where they stand on the issue. They continue to turn their backs on LGBTQ+ representation and communities.

That's something Kim will never do.

As a proud fighter for the LGBTQ+ community, Kim is ready to reaffirm her commitment. For Kim, standing with the LGBTQ+ community this Pride doesn't mean showing support in just June. Democrat Eric Swalwell represents California's 14th Congressional District.
https://ericswalwell.com/ [https://ericswalwell.com/]
Friend, my message is clear: I will always be an ally, advocate, and safe-space for the LGBTQ+ community because LGBTQ+ rights are human rights.

But the fight for equal protection under the law is far from over. As we join hands in celebrating Pride Month this year, members of the LGBTQ+ community face renewed attacks from MAGA extremists who continue to use their identities as a political weapon.

SUPPORT PRIDE 🏳️🌈 » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ESCA-14-Email-June2024-FR-June?&refcode=E8827-20240604-PrideMonth-SB-Holiday&amount=10]

MAGA won’t say it out loud, but it couldn’t be more obvious: Their anti-equality agenda includes action to ban drag performances, ban LGBTQ+ history, and legislation that bans gender-affirming care. Full stop: they’ll continue to try and legislate away the rights of millions of LGBTQ+ Americans.

Not on my watch, friend. This Pride Month we must reaffirm our commitment to celebrating the love and equality that so many in the LGBTQ+ community have fought their entire lives for.

Pride Month is more important than ever for our LGBTQ+ friends, family, and community members. Join me in celebrating Pride Month with open hearts, open minds, and the courage to fight back against hateful, anti-LGBTQ+ rhetoric. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ESCA-14-Email-June2024-FR-June?&refcode=E8827-20240604-PrideMonth-SL-Holiday&amount=10]

At the end of the day, love conquers hate, and love is love.

— Eric

name: Sarah McBride
subject: Thank you
body:
[1]Sarah McBride - Democrat for Congress

With less than 100 days until the September primary election (time flies,
doesn’t it?), it’s been a busy time for our campaign.

But I wanted to make sure that I took a moment to say thank you.

Whether you’ve donated to our campaign, joined me on the doors, shared
special words of encouragement, or simply read our emails, your support
makes a powerful difference.

And while this race is far from over, this campaign’s grassroots energy,
momentum, and growing coalition give me so much hope.

Hope that we can win this race for Delaware’s sole seat in Congress.

Hope that we can expand access to health care, protect the right to
reproductive care, and ensure that every worker is paid a living wage.

Hope that we can build a democracy that’s big enough for all of us.

So thank you for being on Team McBride — for holding fast to our shared
vision that tomorrow will be different.

With gratitude,

Sarah McBride

body:
We are pro-choice, and we are being silenced.

| | | | | [ ](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fourtenn.org%2F/1/010f018fe520a138-a840b471-1b63-45f9-ad5d-92cdd8ffe830-000000/Y8stwaqq7PlLY0lbBXgIVGnGIBs=162)

Dear Peter,
---
| | Women are fleeing the state.

Doctors have to choose between letting a pregnant woman die... or jail time.

Tennessee is forcing women into life-threatening situations due to extreme abortion bans and shockingly narrow medical exceptions. Doctors hesitate to provide critical care, fearing harsh legal repercussions. Women suffer; their health and lives at risk.

**This isn’t just politics - it’s life and death.**[**It is up to us to protect women in Tennessee.**](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Four-tennessee-future-pac-1%3Frefcode=TENN_24_EM_15_ProChoiceTennessee/1/010f018fe520a138-a840b471-1b63-45f9-ad5d-92cdd8ffe830-000000/3ZL7PZF9wExZ_djWDIl8MIGMkK8=162)****

Vanderbilt University recently conducted a statewide poll and found that the majority of Tennessee women are pro-choice.

Yet our voices are being silenced.

This is why we need to elect Champions for Choice.

Allie Phillips is on the front lines, advocating for reproductive rights and challenging these draconian laws.

🔹 Allie’s Promise: As a staunch advocate for women’s health, she has vowed to fight tirelessly for the right to safe and accessible abortion care.
🔹 Allie’s Vision: A Tennessee where every woman can make her own healthcare decisions without fear or restriction.

**But Allie’s dedication isn’t just political—it’s deeply personal. **When Allie faced a complicated pregnancy, she made the difficult decision to have an abortion. It was a choice that saved her life and one she believes every woman should be able to make without government interference.

Allie Phillips represents the change we need. Her dedication to reproductive rights is unwavering, and with your support, we can help her win this crucial battle.

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He’s running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

| Last weekend, the community came together to welcome the start of Pride Month in Annapolis! The Pride Parade & Festival was a beautiful testament to the diversity, resilience, and vibrancy of our community.

While fear and discrimination are tools used all too often to divide – particularly where decisions are made and at the ballot box – Pride reminds us that participation does matter. It matters on sunny parade days in June, it matters when testifying for legislation to expand critical health services for LGBTQ+ neighbors at the State House, it matters when ensuring books that reflect our community and our history are available at our libraries, and participation matters when we elect people to represent and fight for our values.

Friends,
Marjorie Taylor Greene and House Republicans spent our entire COVID-19 hearing attacking Dr. Fauci.
Here’s what I have to say about it:
I lost both my mother and stepdad to COVID-19, so this is personal.
Marjorie Taylor Greene’s comments were shameful. Not only did she blatantly disrespect Dr. Fauci by refusing to address him by his title, referring to him as “Mr. Fauci” and stating, “cause you're not Doctor, you're Mr. Fauci," but she also called for his imprisonment. “That man does not deserve to have a license. As a matter of fact, it should be revoked and he belongs in prison.”
**Let’s make one thing clear: Dr. Fauci is an American hero. He and his team have done more to save lives than all 435 members of the House on both sides of the aisle.**
This type of rhetoric and the crazy COVID conspiracy theories that MTG and the GOP spread have had damaging effects on the lives of Dr. Fauci and his family. They have been subject to a large number of death threats.
Marjorie Taylor Greene has shown time and time again that she is unfit to be a member of the House or any governing body.
Instead of focusing on learning from COVID-19, she used her time to spew unproductive attacks. She does not care for public health and should be removed from the Oversight committee.

body:
Dear Friends and Family, I entered the race for the Third Congressional District on January 17 because I am deeply concerned that the polarization in the country is tearing us apart to the point that | | | [](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=665fcb7c4022b270c2ce4cc1&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.joecohnforcongress.com%2F%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D665fc964396f0a17a301bdf6%26ss_email_id%3D665fcb7c4022b270c2ce4cc1%26ss_campaign_name%3DThank%2Byou%2521%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-06-05T02%253A21%253A06Z&w=65a6a2fba85b39036d9f5042&c=b_665fc964396f0a17a301bdf6&l=en-US&s=EUpfqdJ8Y1PPxZ5Ykbt-b8tK3kU%3D)

| Dear Friends and Family,I entered the race for the Third Congressional District on January 17 because I am deeply concerned that the polarization in the country is tearing us apart to the point that it’s now threatening our democracy and preventing us from tackling pressing issues.I’m writing to you now to let you know that I did not win today’s primary, but more importantly to thank you for all you did to support me in the race.I want to thank my campaign team and incredible volunteers, whose hard work and dedication have been nothing short of extraordinary. Your commitment to our cause and to the people of New Jersey’s 3rd district has been inspiring. I am grateful for your tireless efforts and for the belief you showed in me every step of the way.To my family and friends, thank you for your unwavering support and encouragement. Your love and belief in me have been my foundation, and I could not have undertaken this journey without you.And to every supporter, whether in our district or beyond, thank you for believing in our vision and for standing with me. Your support has meant the world to me, and I’m honored to have earned your trust.Tonight I reached out to each of my opponents to congratulate them on a well-run race and to offer my support to the Democratic Party nominee, Assemblyman Herb Conaway. I urge all of you in the district to join me in supporting Herb as he continues the campaign to represent New Jersey’s 3rd district.We ran a positive campaign focused on ideas, and I hope you are as proud as I am to have been a part of it. I could not have run the race without you and I will be forever grateful.Thank you,
---
| | | |
---
Joe Cohn

Your commitment to our cause and to the people of New Jersey’s 3rd district has been inspiring. I carried these values with me when I was working as a cocktail waitress at Caesars Palace to help pay for college and, later, when I was a computer programmer in a male-dominated field. Today, I carry these values with me as I work in the U.S. Senate.

Peter, I’m excited to kick off June – also known as Pride Month!

I’m proud to be an openly gay Member of Congress. I’ve boldly stood up for the LGBTQ+ community at every turn – from the Equality Act, to trans youth, and even LGBTQ+ servicemembers.

**Today, I want to tell you a bit about my journey as a gay man.**

_I came of age in the 80s_ , during the AIDS crisis – which exacerbated stigmas around queer folks. It was a dark time for the LGBTQ+ community.

When I ran for Congress in the 90s,_I was publicly outed against my will by Republican Ken Calvert._ I lost that race and didn’t get elected to Congress until 2012.

When I was finally elected, I was the _**first** _gay person of color elected to Congress. Since then, our numbers have increased. And the LGBTQ+ community has come so far – including legalizing same-sex marriage in 2015.

But right now, all our progress is at stake. Far-right Republicans are determined to push through a fundamentalist Christian nationalist agenda – _**banning books, abortion, and LGBTQ+ rights.**_

It all comes down to this election, Peter. We can’t let the radical House GOP win another term in the majority.
