# **Could Oregon vote for President Trump this year? You bet! **
---
Hello, I write this email on the heels of President Trump being found guilty in New York, like you I am angry with the weaponization of our justice system on politicians. Just because you don't agree with someone's politics it is wrong, just wrong. I hope this signals to every person in America, if it can happen to Trump it can happen to you. We must all now take a stand and vote for President Trump on November 5th. This is truly our last stand before losing America. I am afraid our biggest threat in America now comes from within. I am afraid for the future of my children. I am afraid our way of life is on life support. However, this will make me fight more and I hope it will galvanize Republicans to vote! I will try to do more newsletters/campaign discussions through the summer and into the fall. Would it not be amazing to see Oregon come into play for President Trump? Wouldn't it be amazing to see Oregon flip red overnight? Let's all work hard over the summer to get folks to register, change to Republican and make sure they vote! My best,Vikki
| **Vikki Breese-Iverson **
**Mom, Wife, Realtor and Rancher**
**Oregon State Representative for HD 59 **
---
|
---
| | GREATER IDAHO PASSES IN CROOK COUNTY
---
| Another County, Crook, voted in a sweeping fashion to join the Greater Idaho movement by forcing the county commissioners and others to have meetings about it. This is in the wake of Portland DARK MONEY groups sending mailers, radio, text messages and more trying to get people to vote against Greater Idaho. Why is Portland Democrats working to strike down a Crook County vote you ask? This is a very good question and I would ask us in Rural Oregon to remember Portland wants to control every part of Oregon. They want to control our water, our land, our communities and our kids. Greater Idaho represents a push back at the ballot box they do not want to see. Now, I will be honest there is a very long difficult road for Greater Idaho to become a reality. I am going to do my best to try to find out how Rural Oregonians can have more independence and more local control from state government. I think this is the real problem.
---
**_Primary Results_** _ _ I want to thank everyone who voted for me in House District 59. I was able to secure 90% of the vote in my primary and also secured more Republican votes than anyone else in the House. This is a humbling and exciting for me to have so much support from my District to represent them in Salem. The biggest thrill for me was my son voted for me for the first time as a new 18-year old voter, it was exciting to hear his thought process as he worked through the ballot. A funny part was when he said, "who are all these judges that have no one running against them?" The results from across the state were very telling to Republicans, we need to turn out and vote. Less than 35% of voters sent their ballots in a few weeks ago. We have to do better or a smaller number of people will determine our future in Oregon. I am pretty sure this will be a theme many of us talk about over the summer about what will it take to get us to 90%? I think the answer lies in getting our system of voting secure and transparent. People have to feel comfortable their vote matters and will actually get counted. Voters used to feel comfortable giving their ballot to some person sitting in a school gym, hoping that ballot was counted right. Putting it in the mail is now seen as not secure. I am baffled by this, but I think it is more about trust in government than the method in which we vote. We don't trust the mail, we don't trust Secretary of State and we see ballots show up in the middle of the night or days later. This has all led to the system failing, layer on motor voter, and you get today's environment. Full results across the state you can find on the SOS page. [_https://results.oregonvotes.gov/ _](https://026s4.mjt.lu/lnk/AWoAAETiS94AAAAWpeQAAC7a4LMAAAAATF0AAUT4ABvaFABmX6aiStWomXkLRWSHMrrE2-L-zAAasDI/1/8_6Pls7Ghcm9VFJy0stcWA/aHR0cHM6Ly9yZXN1bHRzLm9yZWdvbnZvdGVzLmdvdi8)
**Housing News** My district in Central Oregon is booming right now as people are fleeing cities for the lovely lifestyle here in the high desert. We are seeing population increases of 1% a year, which is a lot! This story from the [_Madras Pioneer_](https://026s4.mjt.lu/lnk/AWoAAETiS94AAAAWpeQAAC7a4LMAAAAATF0AAUT4ABvaFABmX6aiStWomXkLRWSHMrrE2-L-) outlines the housing production happening in Central Oregon right now. We must be building in all levels of homes to get us up to a level of building following the need from growth.Being a licensed REALTOR in Oregon and a principal broker, I am seeing this all to well. The number of homes for sell is not sufficient to fill the demand. Sadly, there are commissioners and other folks in Central Oregon looking to chop off the supply. Recently I attended a conference on housing and water discussions in Central Oregon, where people are actively against building more homes. You can not lower the price of homes or fix a supply issue without more homes and more land. There is no way the government will fix the problem, only the market can. Instead of blaming developers for water wells going dry, let's focus on removing juniper trees from water sheds and making more water flow. These weeds are horrible for water consumption sucking up gallons of water per day per tree. There is enough water if we get it out of the Juniper trees and into homes.
In talking about housing, I recently was able to do a bill signing for my bill that passed the Legislature back in February. This bi partisan bill really helps the process of buying and selling a home be more transparent, and makes whole selling people register with the state to make sure we do not have bad actors in real estate. I thank Senator Meek and Senator Anderson for joining me for the bill signing with the Governor. Realtors are, and should be, leading the effort to make our industry transparent and safe so people want to use a professional when purchasing or selling their home.
|
---
| Finally
---
I will end this newsletter with a promotion for my husband new Podcast with Reagan Knopp - CROSSTABS. Bryan and Reagan bring some interesting insights to politics and legislation. This year, they will be talking about some interesting topics I am sure. Go to [_https://www.crosstabs.studio/_](https://026s4.mjt.lu/lnk/AWoAAETiS94AAAAWpeQAAC7a4LMAAAAATF0AAUT4ABvaFABmX6aiStWomXkLRWSHMrrE2-L-zAAasDI/3/pb-uVFzxWHxcOL7x-q8XIA/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY3Jvc3N0YWJzLnN0dWRpby8)

I am Susie Lee’s worst nightmare. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/d25a83e53e3d/he-should-never-be-in-a-position-of-power-12696654?e=54a81bd33c)
---
| | Dear Peter,
---
| | Recently the Democratic Party of Nevada put out a press release and took a hit at me: ****
---
| **_"In CD-3, MAGA extremist Elizabeth Helgelien was so determined to be at the MAGA convention that she drove through a blizzard. She took some time to congratulate insurrectionist Scott Presler, who helped plan “stop the steal,” on his “inspiring talk.” Wonder what they talked about?"_**

It is fascinating to me how out of touch the Democratic Party is, when they use “Making America Great Again” as some sort of pejorative adjective.

What’s the alternative? _Making America Terrible Again? _

_They are already making good progress on that goal with Joe Biden and Susie Lee in office._

I was proud to be at the Nevada Republican convention, two of my opponents could not be bothered to engage and talk to the grassroots conservatives of the great state of Nevada.

The Democrats love to attack me because they know exactly what I will do when I am in Washington D.C.

_Exactly what I did in Carson City as State Senator: Vote conservative 100% of the time._

And they know that if I am the nominee,**I will beat Susie Lee.**

[Our election is on June 11th and coming soon, will you help us get across the finish line?](https://elizabethfornv.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ab8092551f57aee37054250c5&id=0b042b72cf&e=54a81bd33c)

Elizabeth Helgelien**
